import importlib.util,json,tempfile,unittest
from pathlib import Path

class WorkerJobAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        path=Path(__file__).parents[1]/'bin/worker_jobs.py'
        self.assertTrue(path.exists(),'durable policy/job core missing')
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('jobs',path);self.m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(self.m)
        self.tmp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup);self.db=Path(self.tmp.name)/'private/jobs.db'
        self.policy=json.loads((path.parents[1]/'settings/worker-policy.json').read_text())
        self.store=self.m.JobStore(self.db,self.policy)
    def propose(self,job='job1',project='scratch',checkout='/tmp/project',tool='codex'):
        return self.store.propose(job,project,'blackwall',tool,checkout,'Write fixture function','Only disposable fixture changes')
    def approve(self,job='job1',exception=False):
        return self.store.approve(job,owner_reply_receipt='verified-owner-message-01',reason='Owner selected tool and host',task_exception=exception)
    def test_no_dispatch_without_explicit_choice_and_changed_scope_invalidates(self):
        self.propose()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.store.claim('job1')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.store.approve('job1',owner_reply_receipt='',reason='missing receipt')
        self.approve();self.store.revise('job1',scope='Changed scope')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.store.claim('job1')
        self.approve();self.store.claim('job1');self.assertEqual(self.store.get('job1')['state'],'queued')
    def test_alias_locks_and_task_exception_do_not_unlock_project(self):
        self.propose(project='mitmproxy')
        self.assertEqual(self.store.get('job1')['request']['project'],'aico/mitmproxy')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.approve()
        self.approve(exception=True);self.store.claim('job1')
        self.propose('job2',project='aico/mitmproxy',checkout='/tmp/other')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.approve('job2')
        self.propose('job3',project='quickshard',checkout='/tmp/third',tool='claude_code')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.approve('job3',exception=True)
    def test_idempotence_policy_change_and_restart_preserve_evidence(self):
        first=self.propose();self.assertEqual(first['fingerprint'],self.propose()['fingerprint'])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.propose(checkout='/tmp/different')
        self.approve();changed=json.loads(json.dumps(self.policy));changed['global_concurrency']=2
        restarted=self.m.JobStore(self.db,changed)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):restarted.claim('job1')
        self.assertEqual(restarted.get('job1')['state'],'awaiting_owner')
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(restarted.events('job1')),3)
        self.assertEqual(self.db.stat().st_mode & 0o777,0o600)
    def test_parallel_connections_claim_once_and_checkout_lease_releases_only_with_evidence(self):
        self.propose();self.approve();second=self.m.JobStore(self.db,self.policy)
        self.store.claim('job1')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):second.claim('job1')
        self.store.prepare_start('job1');self.store.mark_running('job1','native-session-01')
        self.propose('job2',checkout='/tmp/project');self.approve('job2')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):second.claim('job2')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.store.finish('job1','completed','')
        self.store.finish('job1','completed','artifact-and-exit-proof-01')
        second.claim('job2');self.assertEqual(second.get('job2')['state'],'queued')

    def test_policy_change_between_queue_and_start_releases_unstarted_lease(self):
        self.propose();self.approve();self.store.claim('job1')
        changed=json.loads(json.dumps(self.policy));changed['policy_version']=2
        restarted=self.m.JobStore(self.db,changed)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):restarted.prepare_start('job1')
        self.assertEqual(restarted.get('job1')['state'],'awaiting_owner')
        restarted.approve('job1',owner_reply_receipt='new-choice',reason='owner confirms new policy')
        restarted.claim('job1')

    def test_concurrent_claim_race_and_foreign_database_refusal(self):
        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
        from threading import Barrier
        self.propose();self.approve();second=self.m.JobStore(self.db,self.policy);barrier=Barrier(2)
        def claim(store):
            barrier.wait()
            try:store.claim('job1');return 'admitted'
            except ValueError:return 'denied'
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            results=list(pool.map(claim,[self.store,second]))
        self.assertCountEqual(results,['admitted','denied'])
        import sqlite3
        foreign=Path(self.tmp.name)/'foreign.db'
        from contextlib import closing
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(foreign)) as db:
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE unrelated(value TEXT)');db.commit()
        before=foreign.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.m.JobStore(foreign,self.policy)
        self.assertEqual(foreign.read_bytes(),before)

    def test_starting_lease_survives_restart_and_unstarted_cannot_complete(self):
        self.propose();self.approve();self.store.claim('job1')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.store.finish('job1','completed','not-real-completion')
        self.store.prepare_start('job1')
        restarted=self.m.JobStore(self.db,self.policy)
        self.assertEqual(restarted.get('job1')['state'],'starting')
        self.propose('job2',checkout='/tmp/second');self.approve('job2')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):restarted.claim('job2')
        restarted.finish('job1','cancelled','owned-runner-termination-proof')
        restarted.claim('job2')

    def test_invalid_config_cannot_enable_auto_or_unknown_worker(self):
        for key,value in [('routing_mode','auto'),('tools','codex'),('hosts',['unknown']),('schema_version',True)]:
            policy=json.loads(json.dumps(self.policy));policy[key]=value
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.m.JobStore(Path(self.tmp.name)/('invalid-'+key+'.db'),policy)
        self.assertFalse(any(Path(self.tmp.name).glob('invalid-*.db')))

class SnapshotAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):

            src = root / 'home'

            db.execute('create table sample(value text)')

            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, 'snapshot helper must succeed on a live committed WAL database: ' + result.stderr)
            self.assertNotIn('fixture-only', result.stdout + result.stderr)
[CONSERVATIVE CREDENTIAL-SHAPED LINE WITHHELD]
            self.assertEqual((dest / '.env').stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o600)

            self.assertFalse((dest / 'hermes-agent').exists())
            self.assertFalse((dest / 'external-link').exists())
            self.assertFalse((dest / 'state.db-wal').exists())

            self.assertEqual(restored.execute('select value from sample').fetchone(), ('committed WAL data',))
            restored.close()

            self.assertEqual(manifest['sqlite_count'], 1)
            restored_dir = root / 'isolated-restore'
            verify = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), '--verify', str(dest), '--restore-to', str(restored_dir)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(verify.returncode, 0, verify.stderr)
[CONSERVATIVE CREDENTIAL-SHAPED LINE WITHHELD]
            restored_db = sqlite3.connect(restored_dir / 'state.db')
            self.assertEqual(restored_db.execute('select value from sample').fetchone(), ('committed WAL data',))
            restored_db.close()
            again = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), '--source', str(src), '--destination', str(dest)], capture_output=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(again.returncode, 0, 'must not overwrite an existing snapshot')
            db.close()


    def test_snapshot_and_verify_release_sqlite_handles(self):
        script = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/runtime-snapshot.py'
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('snapshot_resources', script)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary); source = root / 'runtime'; source.mkdir()
            db = sqlite3.connect(source / 'state.db')
            db.execute('create table sample(value text)'); db.commit(); db.close()
            gc.collect()
            with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as observed:
                warnings.simplefilter('always', ResourceWarning)
                module.snapshot(source, root / 'snapshot')
                module.verify(root / 'snapshot')
                gc.collect()
            self.assertEqual([str(w.message) for w in observed if issubclass(w.category, ResourceWarning)], [],
                             'snapshot/verify must close database handles before returning')

class RuntimeStagingAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_daily_archive_retention_never_removes_unowned_data(self):
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/stage-runtime-backup.py'
        self.assertTrue(path.exists(), 'daily staging helper is not implemented')
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('stage', path)
        stage = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(stage)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            source = root / 'runtime'
            source.mkdir()
            (source / '.env').write_text('KEY=private-fixture')
            db = sqlite3.connect(source / 'state.db')
            db.execute('pragma journal_mode=wal')
            db.execute('create table jobs(value text)')
            db.execute("insert into jobs values('committed')")
            db.commit()
            destination = root / 'staging'
            stage.stage(source, destination, today=date(2026, 10, 1), minimum_free_bytes=0)
            foreign = destination / '2026-09-01'
            foreign.mkdir()
            (foreign / 'owner-note').write_text('preserve')
            first = stage.stage(source, destination, today=date(2026, 10, 8), minimum_free_bytes=0)
            (source / '.env').write_text('KEY=new-live-value')
            second = stage.stage(source, destination, today=date(2026, 10, 8), minimum_free_bytes=0)
            self.assertTrue(second['reused_daily_archive'])
            self.assertEqual((destination / '2026-10-08/.env').read_text(), 'KEY=private-fixture')
            archived = sqlite3.connect(destination / '2026-10-08/state.db')
            self.assertEqual(archived.execute('select value from jobs').fetchone(), ('committed',))
            archived.close()
            stage.stage(source, destination, today=date(2026, 10, 15), minimum_free_bytes=0)
            self.assertFalse((destination / '2026-10-01').exists())
            self.assertTrue((foreign / 'owner-note').exists())
            self.assertTrue((destination / '2026-10-08').exists())
            self.assertEqual((destination / '2026-10-15/.env').stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o600)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                stage.stage(source, source / 'inside', minimum_free_bytes=0)
            db.close()


    def test_fresh_same_day_archive_preserves_old_and_failed_refresh(self):
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/stage-runtime-backup.py'
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('stage_refresh', path)
        stage = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(stage)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp);source=root/'runtime';source.mkdir();destination=root/'staging'
            (source/'.env').write_text('KEY=original')
            stage.stage(source,destination,today=date(2026,10,8),minimum_free_bytes=0)
            (source/'.env').write_text('KEY=replacement')
            fresh=stage.stage(source,destination,today=date(2026,10,8),minimum_free_bytes=0,refresh=True)
            revised=destination/fresh['archive_name']
            self.assertNotEqual(revised.name,'2026-10-08')
            self.assertEqual((revised/'.env').read_text(),'KEY=replacement')
            self.assertEqual((destination/'2026-10-08/.env').read_text(),'KEY=original')
            stage.archive.verify(revised)
            before={p.name for p in destination.iterdir()}
            with patch.object(stage.archive,'snapshot',side_effect=RuntimeError('failed snapshot')):
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                    stage.stage(source,destination,today=date(2026,10,8),minimum_free_bytes=0,refresh=True)
            self.assertEqual(before,{p.name for p in destination.iterdir()})
            stage.archive.verify(revised)
            foreign=destination/'2026-10-01T000000Z-deadbeef';foreign.mkdir();(foreign/'keep').write_text('foreign')
            stage.stage(source,destination,today=date(2026,10,22),minimum_free_bytes=0)
            self.assertFalse(revised.exists())
            self.assertTrue((foreign/'keep').exists())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,tempfile,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date

class NightlyInclusionAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    def load(self):
        path=Path(__file__).parents[1]/'bin/audit-nightly-inclusion.py'
        self.assertTrue(path.exists(),'read-only inclusion auditor not implemented')
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('inclusion',path);module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module);return module

    def test_new_encrypted_root_snapshot_matches_current_archive(self):
        m=self.load()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base=Path(tmp)/'cloud';root=base/'hermes';staging=root/'private/runtime-staging';archive=staging/'2026-10-08T185500Z-deadbeef';archive.mkdir(parents=True)
            contents={'.env':b'KEY=fixture','config.yaml':b'model: fixture'}
            for n,c in contents.items():(archive/n).write_bytes(c)
            manifest={'created_at':'2026-10-08T18:55:00+00:00','managed_by':'hermes-runtime-staging-v1','files':{n:{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(c).hexdigest()} for n,c in contents.items()}}
            raw=json.dumps(manifest).encode();(archive/'snapshot-manifest.json').write_bytes(raw)
            snapshots=[{'id':'a'*64,'hostname':'blackwall','paths':[str(base)],'time':'2026-10-08T19:30:00+00:00'}]
            def command(args):
                if args==['snapshots','--json']:return json.dumps(snapshots).encode()
                self.assertEqual(args[0],'dump');self.assertEqual(args[1],'a'*64)
                return (archive/Path(args[2]).name).read_bytes()
            result=m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),command)
            self.assertTrue(result['encrypted_manifest_matches']);self.assertTrue(result['credential_and_config_hashes_match'])
            self.assertFalse(result['full_disaster_restore_proven'])
            snapshots[0]['time']='2026-10-08T18:00:00+00:00'
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),command)
            snapshots[0]['time']='2026-10-08T19:30:00+00:00'
            original_host=snapshots[0]['hostname'];snapshots[0]['hostname']='unrelated-host'
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),command)
            snapshots[0]['hostname']=original_host
            original_paths=snapshots[0]['paths'];snapshots[0]['paths']=[str(archive)]
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),command)
            snapshots[0]['paths']=original_paths
            def corrupted_dump(args):
                if args[0]=='dump' and args[2].endswith('/.env'):return b'wrong encrypted fixture'
                return command(args)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),corrupted_dump)
            (archive/'.env').write_bytes(b'wrong fixture')
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),command)

    def test_unowned_and_symlink_archive_are_not_proof(self):
        m=self.load()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base=Path(tmp);root=base/'hermes';staging=root/'private/runtime-staging';staging.mkdir(parents=True)
            outside=base/'outside';outside.mkdir();(outside/'snapshot-manifest.json').write_text('{}')
            (staging/'2026-10-08').symlink_to(outside,target_is_directory=True)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),lambda _:self.fail('must not query repository'))
            (staging/'2026-10-08').unlink()
            foreign=staging/'2026-10-08';foreign.mkdir();(foreign/'snapshot-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'managed_by':'someone-else'}))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):m.audit(root,base,date(2026,10,8),lambda _:self.fail('must not query repository'))
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

class HealthStateAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_transient_failure_delivery_retry_dedup_and_recovery(self):
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/health-monitor.py'
        self.assertTrue(path.exists(), 'health monitor is not implemented')
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('monitor', path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        state, events = module.advance({}, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'down')])
        # No delivery ack: retry the current outage on the next tick.
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'down')])
        module.acknowledge(state, events)
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'recovered')])
        module.acknowledge(state, events)
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        # If delivery was unavailable throughout the outage, report recovery,
        # rather than sending an obsolete "down" alert after connectivity returns.
        state, _ = module.advance({}, {'gateway': False})
        state, _ = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'recovered-before-delivery')])

    def test_dashboard_rejects_html_and_missing_auth_boundary(self):
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/health-monitor.py'
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('monitor_http', path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        module.http = lambda url: (200, b'<html>Cloudflare login</html>')
        self.assertFalse(module.dashboard_healthy('https://example.invalid'))
        metadata = b'{"providers":[{"name":"basic","supports_password":true}]}'
        module.http = lambda url: (200, metadata)
        self.assertFalse(module.dashboard_healthy('https://example.invalid'))
        module.http = lambda url: (401, b'') if url.endswith('/api/auth/me') else (200, metadata)
        self.assertTrue(module.dashboard_healthy('https://example.invalid'))


class PassiveInferenceAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_billing_failure_newer_success_expiry_and_mutable_session_model(self):
        # A catalog-only check misses this real failure; a mutable model label must not fake recovery.
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/health-monitor.py'
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('monitor_passive', path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        self.assertTrue(hasattr(module, 'passive_spark_turn_status'), 'passive inference check is missing')
        now = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            db = Path(temporary) / 'state.db'
            c = sqlite3.connect(db)
            c.executescript('CREATE TABLE sessions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, model TEXT, billing_provider TEXT, billing_base_url TEXT); '
                            'CREATE TABLE messages(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT, role TEXT, '
                            'timestamp REAL, finish_reason TEXT, display_kind TEXT, display_metadata TEXT);')
            c.execute('INSERT INTO sessions VALUES(?,?,?,?)', ('probe', 'muse-spark-1.3-contributor', 'custom', 'http://127.0.0.1:19190/v1'))
            c.commit()
            self.assertIsNone(module.passive_spark_turn_status(db, now))
            metadata = json.dumps({'error':'private details must never leave the database',
                                   'error_surface':{'provider':'custom', 'model':'muse-spark-1.3-contributor',
                                                    'code':'billing'}})
            c.execute('INSERT INTO messages VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                      (1,'probe','assistant',now.timestamp()-20,None,'failed_turn',metadata))
            c.commit()
            original = db.read_bytes()
            self.assertFalse(module.passive_spark_turn_status(db, now))
            self.assertEqual(db.read_bytes(), original, 'observer modified its input database')
            c.execute('INSERT INTO messages VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                      (2,'probe','assistant',now.timestamp()-10,'stop',None,None));c.commit()
            self.assertTrue(module.passive_spark_turn_status(db, now))
            # The same model name at another custom endpoint does not recover this account.
            c.execute('UPDATE sessions SET billing_base_url=?', ('https://unrelated.example/v1',));c.commit()
            self.assertFalse(module.passive_spark_turn_status(db, now))
            c.execute('UPDATE sessions SET billing_base_url=?', ('http://127.0.0.1:19190/v1',));c.commit()
            # A later model switch makes earlier success attribution uncertain: don't report recovery.
            c.execute('INSERT INTO messages VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                      (3,'probe','user',now.timestamp()-5,None,'model_switch',None));c.commit()
            self.assertFalse(module.passive_spark_turn_status(db, now))
            # Expiring evidence does not declare the provider recovered.
            from datetime import timedelta
            self.assertIsNone(module.passive_spark_turn_status(db, now+timedelta(days=2)))
            c.close()



class NightlyAuditObservation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_failed_stale_and_verified_audit(self):
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('nightly_monitor',Path(__file__).parents[1]/'bin/health-monitor.py')
        m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
        self.assertTrue(hasattr(m,'nightly_inclusion_status'),'nightly observer missing')
        now=datetime(2026,10,8,20,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path=Path(tmp)/'state.json'
            self.assertIsNone(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))
            path.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'failed','verified_at':now.isoformat()}))
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))
            path.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'verified','verified_at':now.isoformat()}))
            self.assertTrue(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))
            from datetime import timedelta
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now+timedelta(hours=28)))
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now-timedelta(minutes=1)))
            path.write_text('invalid')
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

    68	def verify(snapshot_dir, restore_to=None):
    69	    snapshot_dir = snapshot_dir.resolve(strict=True)
    70	    manifest = json.loads((snapshot_dir / 'snapshot-manifest.json').read_text())
    71	    if restore_to is not None:
    72	        restore_to.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
    73	    for relative, item in manifest['files'].items():
    74	        rel = Path(relative)
    75	        if rel.is_absolute() or '..' in rel.parts:
    76	            raise ValueError('invalid archive path')
    77	        p = snapshot_dir / rel
    78	        if p.is_symlink() or hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != item['sha256']:
    79	            raise ValueError('archive content mismatch')
    80	        if restore_to is not None:
    81	            dest = restore_to / rel
    82	            dest.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    83	            shutil.copyfile(p, dest)
    84	            os.chmod(dest, 0o600)  # test restore stays private; real restore modes are in manifest
    85	            p = dest
    86	        if item['sqlite']:
    87	            with closing(sqlite3.connect(p.as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True)) as db:
    88	                if db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall() != [('ok',)]:
    89	                    raise ValueError('restored SQLite integrity failed')
    90	    return manifest

3. IMPORTANT: global DNS also participates in unmatched queries. To preserve other queries' existing path, give eth0 the root route ~. via /etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-eth0.network.d/60-hermes-dns-route.conf, [Network] Domains=~. # M4/M5 implementation interfaces — additive planning baseline

Implementation starts only after phone question/status interface and M2/M3 foundations have evidence. These contracts fix ownership now; adapter commands and cutover procedures are refined against installed versions immediately before execution.

## Worker job / owner decision contract

Persist Blackwall-owned job_id, project_id, canonical repo/checkout and host, policy_version, requested goal/scope, chosen worker/model/auth mode, owner approval and reason, timestamps, run/session handle, log/artifact locations, heartbeat, result/evidence and cancellation status. States: proposed → awaiting_owner → approved → queued → running → completed/failed/cancelled. Approval is bound to the selected tool, host and scope; material changes return to awaiting_owner. Cancellation needs process-group ownership and actual termination evidence, never random terminal input.

Project aliases resolve to canonical identity before lock checks. aico/mitmproxy is Claude-only with explicit per-task Codex exception; Quickshard is Codex; others undecided. Policy edits invalidate incompatible queued approvals, preserve previous audit version, and ask before resuming. Host choice still asks even for a locked tool. Root capability does not replace this user-requested decision workflow.

Adapters use absolute installed paths and project-isolated environment: remove billed ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY and endpoint/auth overrides from Claude/Codex child invocation only; retain shared credentials for unrelated workflows. Use installed supported structured noninteractive output and resume commands, verify subscription identity without printing token, and preserve tool-native session stores. OpenCode receives exact configured Spark model and owner key environment; no provider/account switch on failure. Check no competing server before any OpenCode service operation.

One writer per checkout. Before task edits, capture git status and project instructions; isolate with worktree when supported and needed, preserving existing changes and correct Git identity. Result requires actual diff/checks/artifact plus explicit limitations. CLI success is not deployment/runtime proof. Phone disconnect leaves the approved job supervised; duplicate submission uses job_id/idempotency, not a second worker. Bounded disposable tasks first, then actual projects only under owner tool/host choice.

## Two-host reachability / transfer contract

Blackwall owns state/scheduler and remains independent of PC. PC reachability is capability-specific: SSH/files, live desktop/browser, emulator, device ADB. A healthy shell tunnel does not prove a paired device or GUI. Record last-seen and route health; PC offline puts dependent jobs in waiting with owner-visible reason, never silently moves project/tool.

Cloudflare preferred; inventory exact ingress/account/Access auth before edits. Repair TCP bridge singleton/systemd ownership with readiness and reconnect tests. Remote ADB server uses adb -H/-P; selected serial must match requested device. Pixel cellular ADB has its own pairing/outbound-bridge experiment; do not expose raw unauthenticated ports. No work-Tailscale infrastructure route. WG retained only until tested replacement/fallback decision; retirement requires callers/rice UI checks, recorded rollback and owner consultation for disruption.

Transfers use scoped manifest and dry-run, inspect source/destination git drift, content hashes and overwrite conflicts. Code/artifacts only, never live SQLite/WAL or shared OAuth refresh tokens. Keep cloudsync's existing project/Claude workflow. Publish canonical runbook references to Claude/Codex/OpenCode after verified paths; each host keeps its own installs/auth, Blackwall-owned relevant knowledge index links provenance.

Resource admission reads MemAvailable, swap and disk, active builds/emulators and owned leases. PC currently has no swap and tight disk; no emulator until margin is sufficient. Place entire owned build/process group under measured limits, not just Java heap. One owned emulator, boot readiness and device proof; clean shutdown returns resources. Never reclaim unrelated processes. If unavailable, propose waiting/Pixel/alternative host and obtain required host decision.

Baseline created 2026-10-07. Preserve this baseline and append amendments; update checkboxes/evidence without dropping requirements. This is the master architecture and milestone roadmap. **Goal:** Daily phone-controlled, voice-capable Hermes on Blackwall that operates both machines and orchestrates subscription Claude Code/Codex and configured OpenCode, with later phased personal communications training.

**Architecture:** Blackwall owns the coordinator, active task registry, decision log, notifications and scheduler. Arch PC supplies optional local workloads, GUI/browser and KVM emulator capacity. Android Relay is the first client. Cloudflare is the preferred access transport, independent of work Tailscale. Explicit project/tool rules and configurable ask-first routing govern coding workers.

**Tech stack:** Existing Hermes Python install, systemd user services, fish CLI workers, authenticated HTTPS/WebSocket dashboard, Cloudflare Tunnel/Access where compatible, existing Docker/Traefik infrastructure, SQLite-consistent snapshots, canonical Markdown knowledge/runbooks, existing cloudsync for its actual project-sync scope.

## Review focus and difficult conditions

1. PC off, network/IP changes or work Tailscale switch: core phone chat/voice/work survives; PC-required jobs wait with clear reason.
2. Android locked/background/doze/reboot or Wi-Fi→cellular change: no duplicate task, recover session/audio, distinguish missed notification from failed execution.
3. Expired/limited subscription or failed Spark route: no paid fallback or silent tool choice; owner question with resumable blocked task.
4. Crash/restart/multiple workers: one owner per task, durable job/run IDs, leases and cancellation; no hidden coding dispatch before routing approval.
5. Cross-host sync or backup: no resurrected retired scripts, no overwritten uncommitted edits, no corrupted WAL databases; restore test proves recovery.

"""Internal policy/job ledger. No worker execution or owner-message authentication.

Only a future authenticated owner adapter may supply approval receipts. Canonical
checkout identity must be resolved on the selected host before proposing a job.
"""
from contextlib import contextmanager,closing
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import copy,hashlib,json,os,sqlite3,tempfile
from pathlib import PurePosixPath,Path


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()

class JobStore:
    def __init__(self,path,policy):
        self.policy=copy.deepcopy(policy)
        if (type(policy.get('schema_version')) is not int or policy.get('schema_version')!=1 or type(policy.get('policy_version')) is not int
                or policy['policy_version']<1 or policy.get('routing_mode') not in ('ask','suggest')
                or policy.get('autonomy_enabled') is not False
                or type(policy.get('global_concurrency')) is not int or policy['global_concurrency']<1
                or policy.get('worker_auth',{}).get('codex')!='subscription_only'
                or policy.get('worker_auth',{}).get('claude_code')!='subscription_only'):
            raise ValueError('unsupported or invalid policy; autonomy remains disabled')
        for field,allowed in [('tools',{'claude_code','codex','opencode'}),('hosts',{'blackwall','arch'})]:
            values=policy.get(field)
            if (not isinstance(values,list) or not values or not all(isinstance(x,str) for x in values)
                    or len(set(values))!=len(values) or not set(values)<=allowed):
                raise ValueError('invalid supported tool/host list')
        if not isinstance(policy.get('aliases'),dict) or not isinstance(policy.get('project_locks'),dict):
            raise ValueError('project alias and lock mappings required')
        self.policy_hash=digest(self.policy);self.path=Path(path)
        if self.path.is_symlink():raise ValueError('job database must not be a symlink')
        self.path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        if self.path.parent.stat().st_uid!=os.getuid():raise ValueError('job directory not owned by caller')
        if self.path.exists():self.validate_existing()
        self.path.parent.chmod(0o700)
        if not self.path.exists():
            descriptor,temporary=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f'.{self.path.name}.init-',dir=self.path.parent)
            os.close(descriptor);temporary=Path(temporary)
            try:
                # Publish only a committed schema. Hard-link publication never replaces a winner.
                with self.transaction(temporary) as db:
                    statements=[
                        'CREATE TABLE ledger_metadata(schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL)',
                        'INSERT INTO ledger_metadata VALUES(1)',
                        'CREATE TABLE jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, approval TEXT, session TEXT, evidence TEXT)',
                        'CREATE TABLE events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL)',
                        'CREATE TABLE leases(host TEXT NOT NULL, checkout TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(host,checkout))']
                    for statement in statements:db.execute(statement)
                with temporary.open('rb') as stream:os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                try:os.link(temporary,self.path)
                except FileExistsError:pass
            finally:
                temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        self.validate_existing()
        self.path.chmod(0o600)

    def validate_existing(self):
        if self.path.is_symlink() or self.path.stat().st_uid!=os.getuid():
            raise ValueError('job database must be owned and not a symlink')
        try:
            with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path.resolve().as_uri()+"?mode=ro&immutable=1",uri=True)) as probe:
                metadata=probe.execute("SELECT schema_version FROM ledger_metadata").fetchall()
        except sqlite3.DatabaseError as error:raise ValueError("refusing unrelated or corrupt database") from error
        if metadata!=[(1,)]:raise ValueError("unsupported job ledger schema")

    @contextmanager
    def transaction(self,path=None):
        db=sqlite3.connect(self.path if path is None else path,timeout=10,isolation_level=None);db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
        try:
            db.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=10000');db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
            yield db
            if db.in_transaction:db.commit()
        except Exception:
            if db.in_transaction:db.rollback()
            raise
        finally:db.close()

    def canonical_project(self,project):
        if not isinstance(project,str) or not project.strip():raise ValueError('project required')
        seen=set();aliases=self.policy['aliases']
        while project in aliases and aliases[project]!=project:
            if project in seen:raise ValueError('project alias cycle')
            seen.add(project);project=aliases[project]
        return project

    def request(self,project,host,tool,checkout,goal,scope):
        if host not in self.policy['hosts'] or tool not in self.policy['tools']:raise ValueError('unknown host/tool')
        if (not isinstance(checkout,str) or not checkout.startswith('/')
                or '\x00' in checkout or '..' in PurePosixPath(checkout).parts):raise ValueError('canonical absolute checkout required')
        if not all(isinstance(x,str) and x.strip() for x in (goal,scope)):raise ValueError('goal and scope required')
        return dict(project=self.canonical_project(project),host=host,tool=tool,
                    checkout=str(PurePosixPath(checkout)),goal=goal,scope=scope)

    @staticmethod
    def row(db,job):
        row=db.execute('SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?',(job,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:raise ValueError('job not found')
        return dict(row)

    @staticmethod
    def event(db,job,kind,detail):
        db.execute('INSERT INTO events(job_id,at,kind,detail) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',
                   (job,datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),kind,json.dumps(detail,sort_keys=True)))

    def get(self,job):
        with self.transaction() as db:row=self.row(db,job)
        row['request']=json.loads(row['request']);row['approval']=json.loads(row['approval']) if row['approval'] else None
        return row

    def events(self,job):
        with self.transaction() as db:return [dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM events WHERE job_id=? ORDER BY id',(job,))]

    def propose(self,job,project,host,tool,checkout,goal,scope):
        if not isinstance(job,str) or not job.strip():raise ValueError('stable job id required')
        request=self.request(project,host,tool,checkout,goal,scope);fingerprint=digest(request)
        with self.transaction() as db:
            previous=db.execute('SELECT fingerprint FROM jobs WHERE id=?',(job,)).fetchone()
            if previous:
                if previous['fingerprint']!=fingerprint:raise ValueError('job id already has another scope; revise explicitly')
            else:
                db.execute('INSERT INTO jobs(id,request,fingerprint,state) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(job,json.dumps(request),fingerprint,'awaiting_owner'))
                self.event(db,job,'proposed',{'fingerprint':fingerprint,'policy_version':self.policy['policy_version']})
        return self.get(job)

    def revise(self,job,**changes):
        with self.transaction() as db:
            row=self.row(db,job)
            if row['state'] not in ('awaiting_owner','approved'):raise ValueError('cannot revise admitted or terminal job')
            request=json.loads(row['request']);request.update(changes);request=self.request(**request)
            fingerprint=digest(request)
            db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET request=?,fingerprint=?,state=?,approval=NULL WHERE id=?',(json.dumps(request),fingerprint,'awaiting_owner',job))
            self.event(db,job,'revised_requires_owner',{'fingerprint':fingerprint})

    def permitted(self,request,exception):
        lock=self.policy['project_locks'].get(request['project'])
        return not lock or request['tool']==lock['tool'] or (exception is True and request['tool'] in lock['task_exceptions'])

    def approve(self,job,*,owner_reply_receipt,reason,task_exception=False):
        if not all(isinstance(x,str) and x.strip() for x in (owner_reply_receipt,reason)):raise ValueError('owner receipt and reason required')
        if type(task_exception) is not bool:raise ValueError('explicit exception must be boolean')
        with self.transaction() as db:
            row=self.row(db,job)
            if row['state'] not in ('awaiting_owner','approved'):raise ValueError('job not awaiting choice')
            request=json.loads(row['request'])
            if not self.permitted(request,task_exception):raise ValueError('project tool lock requires valid owner task exception')
            approval={'receipt':owner_reply_receipt,'reason':reason,'task_exception':task_exception,
                      'fingerprint':row['fingerprint'],'policy_hash':self.policy_hash,'policy_version':self.policy['policy_version']}
            db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET state=?,approval=? WHERE id=?',('approved',json.dumps(approval),job))
            self.event(db,job,'owner_choice_recorded',approval)

    def claim(self,job):
        invalid=False
        with self.transaction() as db:
            row=self.row(db,job)
            if row['state']!='approved' or not row['approval']:raise ValueError('explicit owner choice required before admission')
            approval=json.loads(row['approval']);request=json.loads(row['request'])
            if (approval['fingerprint']!=row['fingerprint'] or approval['policy_hash']!=self.policy_hash
                    or not self.permitted(request,approval.get('task_exception'))):
                db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET state=?,approval=NULL WHERE id=?',('awaiting_owner',job))
                self.event(db,job,'approval_invalidated',{'policy_hash':self.policy_hash});invalid=True
            else:
                count=db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leases').fetchone()[0]
                occupied=db.execute('SELECT job_id FROM leases WHERE host=? AND checkout=?',(request['host'],request['checkout'])).fetchone()
                if occupied or count>=self.policy['global_concurrency']:raise ValueError('checkout/global concurrency lease unavailable')
                db.execute('INSERT INTO leases VALUES(?,?,?)',(request['host'],request['checkout'],job))
                db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET state=? WHERE id=?',('queued',job));self.event(db,job,'admitted',{'policy_hash':self.policy_hash})
        if invalid:raise ValueError('policy/task changed; fresh owner choice required')

    def prepare_start(self,job):
        """Must run BEFORE creating any child; starting leases survive restart."""
        invalid=False
        with self.transaction() as db:
            row=self.row(db,job)
            if row['state']!='queued':raise ValueError('job not queued')
            approval=json.loads(row['approval']) if row['approval'] else {}
            request=json.loads(row['request'])
            if (approval.get('fingerprint')!=row['fingerprint'] or approval.get('policy_hash')!=self.policy_hash
                    or not self.permitted(request,approval.get('task_exception'))):
                db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET state=?,approval=NULL WHERE id=?',('awaiting_owner',job))
                db.execute('DELETE FROM leases WHERE job_id=?',(job,))
                self.event(db,job,'approval_invalidated_before_start',{'policy_hash':self.policy_hash});invalid=True
            else:
                db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET state=? WHERE id=?',('starting',job))
                self.event(db,job,'starting',{'policy_hash':self.policy_hash})
        if invalid:raise ValueError('policy/task changed before start; fresh owner choice required')

    def mark_running(self,job,session):
        if not isinstance(session,str) or not session.strip():raise ValueError('native session handle required')
        with self.transaction() as db:
            if self.row(db,job)['state']!='starting':raise ValueError('job not prepared before child launch')
            db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET state=?,session=? WHERE id=?',('running',session,job))
            self.event(db,job,'running',{'session':session})

    def finish(self,job,state,evidence):
        if state not in ('completed','failed','cancelled') or not isinstance(evidence,str) or not evidence.strip():raise ValueError('terminal state requires supervisor evidence')
        with self.transaction() as db:
            if self.row(db,job)['state'] not in ('queued','starting','running'):raise ValueError('no admitted job to finish')
            if state=='completed' and self.row(db,job)['state']!='running':raise ValueError('unstarted job cannot be completed')
            db.execute('UPDATE jobs SET state=?,evidence=? WHERE id=?',(state,evidence,job));db.execute('DELETE FROM leases WHERE job_id=?',(job,))
            self.event(db,job,state,{'evidence':evidence})
        age=(now-datetime.fromisoformat(result['verified_at'])).total_seconds()
        return result.get('status')=='verified' and 0 <= age < 27*3600
    except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,OSError):
        return False


def collect(home, root):
    statuses = {}
    def check(name, fn):
        try:
            statuses[name] = bool(fn())
        except Exception:
            statuses[name] = False
    for name, unit in [('gateway', 'hermes-gateway.service'), ('dashboard', 'hermes-dashboard.service'),
                       ('tunnel', 'hermes-relay-tunnel.service')]:
        check(name, lambda unit=unit: command(['systemctl', '--user', 'is-active', unit]).stdout.strip() == 'active')
    check('spark_container', lambda: json_inspect('hermes-spark-spark-proxy-1')['State']['Running'])
    def spark_models():
        key = selected_env(home / '.hermes/.env', 'MODEL_API_KEY_UCHAPRIMARY')
        if not key:
            return False
        status, body = http('http://127.0.0.1:19190/v1/models', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key})
        return status == 200 and any(m.get('id') == 'muse-spark-1.3-contributor' for m in json.loads(body).get('data', []))
    check('spark_models', spark_models)
    try:
        last_turn = passive_spark_turn_status(home / '.hermes/state.db', datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        statuses['spark_observer'] = True
    except Exception:
        # Unknown provider outcome is never a recovery; observe reader failure separately.
        statuses['spark_observer'] = False
        last_turn = None
    if last_turn is not None:
        statuses['spark_last_observed_turn'] = last_turn
    check('dashboard_local', lambda: dashboard_healthy('http://127.0.0.1:9119'))
    check('dashboard_public', lambda: dashboard_healthy('https://hermes-relay.uchabokeria.space'))
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    def staging():
        result = command(['systemctl', '--user', 'show', 'hermes-runtime-backup.service', '-p', 'Result', '--value'])
        if result.stdout.strip() != 'success':
            return False
        dates = []
        for path in (root / 'private/runtime-staging').glob('*/snapshot-manifest.json'):
            info = json.loads(path.read_text())
            if info.get('managed_by') == 'hermes-runtime-staging-v1':
                dates.append(datetime.fromisoformat(info['created_at']))
        return bool(dates) and 0 <= (now - max(dates)).total_seconds() < 27 * 3600
    check('staging', staging)
    inclusion=nightly_inclusion_status(root/'private/nightly-inclusion-state.json',now)
    if inclusion is None:
        try:
            result=command(['systemctl','--user','show','hermes-nightly-inclusion.service','-p','Result','--value'])
            if result.stdout.strip() in ('exit-code','timeout','signal','resources','core-dump'):
                inclusion=False
        except Exception:
            inclusion=False
    if inclusion is not None:
        statuses['nightly_inclusion']=inclusion
    def cloud_backup():
        p = home / 'opt/cloud/restic/backup.log'
        with p.open('rb') as stream:
            stream.seek(max(0, p.stat().st_size - 4 * 1024**2))
            lines = stream.read().decode(errors='replace').splitlines()
        starts, finishes = [], []
        for line in lines:
            if '=== backup started ===' in line:
                starts.append(datetime.fromisoformat(line.split()[0]))
            if '=== backup complete ===' in line:
                finishes.append(datetime.fromisoformat(line.split()[0]))
        if not finishes or not 0 <= (now - max(finishes)).total_seconds() < 27 * 3600:
            return False
        return not starts or max(starts) <= max(finishes) or (now - max(starts)).total_seconds() < 15 * 60
    check('cloud_backup', cloud_backup)
    check('disk_space', lambda: shutil.disk_usage(root).free >= 4 * 1024**3)
    return statuses


def send_owner(config, text):
    if config.get('channel') != 'telegram':
        return False
    info = json_inspect('notify')
    environment = dict(s.split('=', 1) for s in info['Config']['Env'] if '=' in s)
    owner = str(config['owner_chat_id'])
    if environment.get('TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID') != owner or not owner.isdigit():
        raise RuntimeError('notification recipient mismatch')
    addresses = [v['IPAddress'] for v in info['NetworkSettings']['Networks'].values() if v.get('IPAddress')]
    if not addresses:
        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in EXCLUDED_DIRS and not (base / d).is_symlink())
        relative_dir = base.relative_to(source)
        target_dir = destination / relative_dir
        if target_dir != destination:
            target_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        for name in sorted(files):
            src = base / name
            rel = str(src.relative_to(source))
            mode = src.lstat().st_mode
            if not stat.S_ISREG(mode) or name.endswith(('-wal', '-shm', '-journal', '.lock', '.pid', '.sock')):
                manifest['excluded'].append(rel)
                continue
            dst = destination / rel
            with src.open('rb') as stream:
                is_sqlite = stream.read(16) == b'SQLite format 3\0'
            if is_sqlite:
                with closing(sqlite3.connect(src.as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=30)) as origin:
                    with closing(sqlite3.connect(dst)) as archive:
                        origin.backup(archive, pages=256)
                        if archive.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall() != [('ok',)]:
                            raise ValueError('SQLite snapshot integrity failed')
                manifest['sqlite_count'] += 1
            else:
                shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
            os.chmod(dst, 0o600)
            manifest['files'][rel] = {'mode': stat.S_IMODE(mode), 'sqlite': is_sqlite,
                                      'sha256': hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    meta = destination / 'snapshot-manifest.json'
    meta.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
    os.chmod(meta, 0o600)
    return manifest

    snapshot_dir = snapshot_dir.resolve(strict=True)
    manifest = json.loads((snapshot_dir / 'snapshot-manifest.json').read_text())

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone


class HealthStateAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_transient_failure_delivery_retry_dedup_and_recovery(self):
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/health-monitor.py'
        self.assertTrue(path.exists(), 'health monitor is not implemented')
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('monitor', path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        state, events = module.advance({}, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'down')])
        # No delivery ack: retry the current outage on the next tick.
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'down')])
        module.acknowledge(state, events)
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'recovered')])
        module.acknowledge(state, events)
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [])
        # If delivery was unavailable throughout the outage, report recovery,
        # rather than sending an obsolete "down" alert after connectivity returns.
        state, _ = module.advance({}, {'gateway': False})
        state, _ = module.advance(state, {'gateway': False})
        state, events = module.advance(state, {'gateway': True})
        self.assertEqual(events, [('gateway', 'recovered-before-delivery')])

    def test_missing_inference_database_does_not_suppress_other_incidents(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('monitor_missing_db',Path(__file__).parents[1]/'bin/health-monitor.py')
        m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            home=Path(tmp);root=home/'project';root.mkdir()
            with patch.object(m,'command',return_value=SimpleNamespace(stdout='inactive',returncode=3)), \
                    patch.object(m,'json_inspect',return_value={'State':{'Running':False}}), \
                    patch.object(m,'selected_env',return_value=None), \
                    patch.object(m,'dashboard_healthy',return_value=False):
                # Use a genuinely missing DB; never synthesize a successful provider recovery.
                statuses=m.collect(home,root)
                self.assertFalse(statuses['spark_observer'])
                self.assertFalse(statuses['gateway']);self.assertFalse(statuses['dashboard_public'])
                self.assertNotIn('spark_last_observed_turn',statuses)
                state,_=m.advance({},statuses);_,events=m.advance(state,statuses)
                self.assertIn(('gateway','down'),events)
                # Query interruption must retain the same failure-isolation boundary.
                with patch.object(m,'passive_spark_turn_status',side_effect=sqlite3.OperationalError('private details')):
                    self.assertFalse(m.collect(home,root)['spark_observer'])
                with patch.object(m,'command',side_effect=TimeoutError('private details')):
                    statuses=m.collect(home,root)
                    self.assertFalse(statuses['gateway']);self.assertFalse(statuses['nightly_inclusion'])

    def test_dashboard_rejects_html_and_missing_auth_boundary(self):
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/health-monitor.py'
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('monitor_http', path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        module.http = lambda url: (200, b'<html>Cloudflare login</html>')
        self.assertFalse(module.dashboard_healthy('https://example.invalid'))
        metadata = b'{"providers":[{"name":"basic","supports_password":true}]}'
        module.http = lambda url: (200, metadata)
        self.assertFalse(module.dashboard_healthy('https://example.invalid'))
        module.http = lambda url: (401, b'') if url.endswith('/api/auth/me') else (200, metadata)
        self.assertTrue(module.dashboard_healthy('https://example.invalid'))


class PassiveInferenceAcceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_billing_failure_newer_success_expiry_and_mutable_session_model(self):
        # A catalog-only check misses this real failure; a mutable model label must not fake recovery.
        path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'bin/health-monitor.py'
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('monitor_passive', path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        self.assertTrue(hasattr(module, 'passive_spark_turn_status'), 'passive inference check is missing')
        now = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            db = Path(temporary) / 'state.db'
            c = sqlite3.connect(db)
            c.executescript('CREATE TABLE sessions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, model TEXT, billing_provider TEXT, billing_base_url TEXT); '
                            'CREATE TABLE messages(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT, role TEXT, '
                            'timestamp REAL, finish_reason TEXT, display_kind TEXT, display_metadata TEXT);')
            c.execute('INSERT INTO sessions VALUES(?,?,?,?)', ('probe', 'muse-spark-1.3-contributor', 'custom', 'http://127.0.0.1:19190/v1'))
            c.commit()
            self.assertIsNone(module.passive_spark_turn_status(db, now))
            metadata = json.dumps({'error':'private details must never leave the database',
                                   'error_surface':{'provider':'custom', 'model':'muse-spark-1.3-contributor',
                                                    'code':'billing'}})

def passive_spark_turn_status(db_path, now):
    """Latest attributable terminal outcome; None means unknown, never recovery.

    Read structured failure metadata, not conversations. Session model labels are
    mutable: successful rows in a session with any model switch are ambiguous.
    """
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 1.0
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path.resolve().as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=1.0)) as db:
        db.set_progress_handler(lambda: int(time.monotonic() > deadline), 1000)
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT m.display_kind,m.display_metadata,m.finish_reason,s.model,s.billing_provider,s.billing_base_url,"
            "EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM messages sw WHERE sw.session_id=m.session_id "
            "AND sw.display_kind='model_switch') "
            "FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.id=m.session_id "
            "WHERE m.role='assistant' AND m.timestamp>=? AND m.timestamp<=? "
            "AND (m.display_kind='failed_turn' OR m.finish_reason IN ('stop','end_turn')) "
            "ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT 128",
            (now.timestamp() - 24 * 3600, now.timestamp())).fetchall()
    for kind, metadata, finish, model, provider, base_url, switched in rows:
        if kind == 'failed_turn':
            if not metadata or len(metadata) > 16384:
                continue
            try:
                surface = json.loads(metadata).get('error_surface', {})
                if (surface.get('model') == 'muse-spark-1.3-contributor'
                        and surface.get('provider') in ('custom', 'custom:meta-uchaprimary', 'meta-uchaprimary')):
                    return False
            except (ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError):
                continue
        elif (model == 'muse-spark-1.3-contributor' and not switched
              and provider in ('custom', 'custom:meta-uchaprimary', 'meta-uchaprimary')
              and (base_url or '').rstrip('/') == 'http://127.0.0.1:19190/v1'):
            return True
    return None


def nightly_inclusion_status(path, now):
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    try:
        result=json.loads(path.read_text())
        age=(now-datetime.fromisoformat(result['verified_at'])).total_seconds()
        return result.get('status')=='verified' and 0 <= age < 27*3600
    except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,OSError):
        return False

class NightlyAuditObservation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_failed_stale_and_verified_audit(self):
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('nightly_monitor',Path(__file__).parents[1]/'bin/health-monitor.py')
        m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
        self.assertTrue(hasattr(m,'nightly_inclusion_status'),'nightly observer missing')
        now=datetime(2026,10,8,20,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path=Path(tmp)/'state.json'
            self.assertIsNone(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))
            path.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'failed','verified_at':now.isoformat()}))
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))
            path.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'verified','verified_at':now.isoformat()}))
            self.assertTrue(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))
            from datetime import timedelta
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now+timedelta(hours=28)))
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now-timedelta(minutes=1)))
            path.write_text('invalid')
            self.assertFalse(m.nightly_inclusion_status(path,now))

    'gateway': 'Hermes gateway process', 'dashboard': 'Hermes dashboard process',

def advance(state, statuses, threshold=2):
    state = copy.deepcopy(state)
    checks = state.setdefault('checks', {})
    events = []
    for name, healthy in statuses.items():
        item = checks.setdefault(name, {'failures': 0, 'incident_open': False, 'announced': None})
        item['failures'] = 0 if healthy else item['failures'] + 1
        if not healthy and item['failures'] >= threshold:
            item['incident_open'] = True
            if item['announced'] != 'down':
                events.append((name, 'down'))
        elif healthy and item['incident_open']:
            events.append((name, 'recovered' if item['announced'] == 'down' else 'recovered-before-delivery'))
    return state, events


def acknowledge(state, events):
    for name, kind in events:
        item = state['checks'][name]
        item['announced'] = kind
        if kind != 'down':
            item['incident_open'] = False


def command(args):
    return subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)


def json_inspect(name):
    result = command(['docker', 'inspect', name])
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('container unavailable')
    return json.loads(result.stdout)[0]

    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        parts = shlex.split(line, comments=True)
        if parts and parts[0] == 'export':
    return status == 200 and body.strip() == b'sent'


def save_private(path, content):
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.health-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as stream:
            json.dump(content, stream, indent=2)
            stream.write('\n')
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--dry-run', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--simulate', choices=['failure', 'recovery'])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    home = Path.home()
    root = home / 'opt/cloud/hermes'
    private = root / 'private'
    config_path = private / 'health-config.json'
    if config_path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 != 0o600:
        raise SystemExit('Health configuration must be mode 600')
    config = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
    statuses = {'gateway': args.simulate == 'recovery'} if args.simulate else collect(home, root)
    if args.dry_run:
        print(json.dumps({'dry_run': True, 'statuses': statuses, 'no_message_sent': True}))
        return
    state_path = private / ('health-test-state.json' if args.simulate else 'health-state.json')
    with (private / '.health-monitor.lock').open('a') as lock:
        os.chmod(lock.name, 0o600)
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        state = json.loads(state_path.read_text()) if state_path.exists() else {}
        state, events = advance(state, statuses)
        delivery = None
        if events:
            text = ('TEST — ' if args.simulate else '') + 'Hermes infrastructure\n' + '\n'.join(
                LABELS[name] + ': ' + kind.replace('-', ' ') for name, kind in events)
            try:
                delivery = send_owner(config, text)
            except Exception:
                delivery = False
            if delivery:
                acknowledge(state, events)
        state.update(last_checked_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), last_statuses=statuses,
                     last_delivery_success=delivery, test_mode=bool(args.simulate))
        save_private(state_path, state)
        print(json.dumps({'statuses': statuses, 'event_count': len(events), 'delivery_success': delivery,
                          'test_mode': bool(args.simulate)}))
        if events and delivery is False:
            raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Private runtime archive; SQLite online backup, no WAL copy or secret stdout.

Each database is consistent independently. Quiesce gateway/other writers externally
when a cross-database/configuration-consistent rollback point is required.
"""
import argparse
from contextlib import closing
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sqlite3
import stat
from datetime import datetime, timezone

EXCLUDED_DIRS = {
    'hermes-agent', 'tools', 'installs', 'node_modules', '.venv', 'venv',
    '__pycache__', '.git', 'cache', 'audio_cache', 'image_cache', 'backups',
    '.curator_backups', 'sandboxes', 'logs',
}


def snapshot(source, destination):
    source = source.resolve(strict=True)
    destination = destination.resolve()
    if destination == source or source in destination.parents:
        raise ValueError('destination must be outside runtime source')
    destination.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    manifest = {'created_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                'sqlite_count': 0, 'files': {}, 'excluded': []}
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
        base = Path(base)
        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in EXCLUDED_DIRS and not (base / d).is_symlink())
        relative_dir = base.relative_to(source)
        target_dir = destination / relative_dir
        if target_dir != destination:
            target_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        for name in sorted(files):
            src = base / name
            rel = str(src.relative_to(source))
            mode = src.lstat().st_mode
            if not stat.S_ISREG(mode) or name.endswith(('-wal', '-shm', '-journal', '.lock', '.pid', '.sock')):
                manifest['excluded'].append(rel)
                continue
            dst = destination / rel
            with src.open('rb') as stream:
                is_sqlite = stream.read(16) == b'SQLite format 3\0'
            if is_sqlite:
                with closing(sqlite3.connect(src.as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=30)) as origin:
                    with closing(sqlite3.connect(dst)) as archive:
                        origin.backup(archive, pages=256)
                        if archive.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall() != [('ok',)]:
                            raise ValueError('SQLite snapshot integrity failed')
                manifest['sqlite_count'] += 1
            else:
                shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
            os.chmod(dst, 0o600)
            manifest['files'][rel] = {'mode': stat.S_IMODE(mode), 'sqlite': is_sqlite,
                                      'sha256': hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    meta = destination / 'snapshot-manifest.json'
    meta.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
    os.chmod(meta, 0o600)
    return manifest


def verify(snapshot_dir, restore_to=None):
    snapshot_dir = snapshot_dir.resolve(strict=True)
    manifest = json.loads((snapshot_dir / 'snapshot-manifest.json').read_text())
    if restore_to is not None:
        restore_to.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
    for relative, item in manifest['files'].items():
        rel = Path(relative)
        if rel.is_absolute() or '..' in rel.parts:
            raise ValueError('invalid archive path')
        p = snapshot_dir / rel
        if p.is_symlink() or hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != item['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('archive content mismatch')
        if restore_to is not None:
            dest = restore_to / rel
            dest.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(p, dest)
            os.chmod(dest, 0o600)  # test restore stays private; real restore modes are in manifest
            p = dest
        if item['sqlite']:
            with closing(sqlite3.connect(p.as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True)) as db:
                if db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall() != [('ok',)]:
                    raise ValueError('restored SQLite integrity failed')
    return manifest


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--source', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--destination', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--verify', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--restore-to', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.verify:
        result = verify(args.verify, args.restore_to)
    elif args.source and args.destination and not args.restore_to:
        result = snapshot(args.source, args.destination)
    else:
        parser.error('use source/destination or verify[/restore-to]')
    print(json.dumps({'result': 'ok', 'file_count': len(result['files']),
                      'sqlite_count': result['sqlite_count']}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Daily private SQLite-consistent staging for the existing cloud/R2 backup.

Does not stop writers. Cross-store/configuration quiescence is not guaranteed.
Only dated archives marked as owned by this helper are subject to 14-day retention.
"""
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile

OWNER = 'hermes-runtime-staging-v1'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('runtime_snapshot', Path(__file__).with_name('runtime-snapshot.py'))
archive = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(archive)


def stage(source, destination, *, today=None, minimum_free_bytes=4 * 1024**3, refresh=False):
    today = today or datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()
    source = source.resolve(strict=True)
    if destination.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('staging root must not be a symlink')
    destination = destination.resolve()
    if destination == source or source in destination.parents:
        raise ValueError('staging must be outside runtime source')
    destination.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if destination.stat().st_uid != os.getuid():
        raise ValueError('staging directory must be owned by current user')
    destination.chmod(0o700)
    lock = destination / '.stage.lock'
    with lock.open('a') as handle:
        lock.chmod(0o600)
        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        name = today.isoformat()
        if refresh:
            name += datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("T%H%M%SZ-") + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
        target = destination / name
        reused = target.exists()
        if reused:
            if target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError('daily archive must not be a symlink')
            metadata = json.loads((target / 'snapshot-manifest.json').read_text())
            if metadata.get('managed_by') != OWNER:
                raise ValueError('refusing to replace unowned daily archive')
            manifest = archive.verify(target)
        else:
            if shutil.disk_usage(destination).free < minimum_free_bytes:
                raise RuntimeError('insufficient free disk space for runtime staging')
            # snapshot() requires a nonexistent target; mkdtemp creates a private parent.
            temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.partial-', dir=destination))
            try:
                snapshot_dir = temporary / 'archive'
                manifest = archive.snapshot(source, snapshot_dir)
                manifest['managed_by'] = OWNER
                manifest['consistency_scope'] = 'per-SQLite-store; live writers are not stopped'
                (snapshot_dir / 'snapshot-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
                archive.verify(snapshot_dir)
                snapshot_dir.rename(target)
            finally:
                shutil.rmtree(temporary)
        removed = 0
        cutoff = today - timedelta(days=13)
        for item in destination.iterdir():
            if not item.is_dir() or item.is_symlink() or item.stat().st_uid != os.getuid():
                continue
            try:
                if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(?:T\d{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{8})?", item.name):
                    continue
                day = date.fromisoformat(item.name[:10])
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if day >= cutoff:
                continue
            meta = item / 'snapshot-manifest.json'
            if not meta.is_file() or meta.is_symlink():
                continue
            try:
                owned = json.loads(meta.read_text()).get('managed_by') == OWNER
            except (ValueError, OSError):
                owned = False
            if owned:
                shutil.rmtree(item)
                removed += 1
    return {'result': 'ok', 'date': today.isoformat(), 'file_count': len(manifest['files']),
            'sqlite_count': manifest['sqlite_count'], 'reused_daily_archive': reused, 'refreshed_daily_archive': refresh, 'archive_name': target.name,
            'expired_owned_archives_removed': removed, 'consistency_scope': 'per-SQLite-store'}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    home = Path.home()
    print(json.dumps(stage(home / '.hermes', home / 'opt/cloud/hermes/private/runtime-staging', refresh=True)))
