#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Blackwall-owned ask-first jobs. CLI proposes/status; owner approval is private API."""
import argparse,json,os,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from worker_jobs import JobStore,digest
from worker_runtime import atomic_json,child_environment,execute_owned,now,verify_artifacts,worker_command

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
JOBS=Path.home()/'.hermes/workspace-jobs'

def job_id(value):
    if not isinstance(value,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,79}',value):raise ValueError('invalid stable job id')
    return value

class Workspace:
    def __init__(self,directory,policy,host):
        self.directory=Path(directory);self.host=host;self.store=JobStore(self.directory/'jobs.db',policy)
        (self.directory/'requests').mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
    def propose(self,job,body):
        job=job_id(job);body=dict(body)
        if body.get('host')!=self.host:raise ValueError('selected host unavailable through this executor; no implicit migration')
        original=Path(body['checkout']);checkout=original.resolve(strict=True)
        if str(original)!=str(checkout) or not checkout.is_dir():raise ValueError('resolve canonical selected-host checkout before proposal')
        if not isinstance(body.get('prompt'),str) or not body['prompt'].strip() or len(body['prompt'])>100000:raise ValueError('bounded prompt required')
        if not isinstance(body.get('checks',[]),list):raise ValueError('artifact checks must be a list')
        body['checks']=body.get('checks',[])
        if body['tool']=='opencode' and body.get('model',self.store.policy['worker_auth']['opencode']['model'])!=self.store.policy['worker_auth']['opencode']['model']:
            raise ValueError('OpenCode provider change requires owner policy decision')
        body['scope']=body['scope']+'\nExecution digest: '+digest({k:v for k,v in body.items() if k!='scope'})
        request={k:body[k] for k in ('project','host','tool','checkout','goal','scope')}
        proposed=self.store.propose(job,**request)
        path=self.directory/'requests'/f'{job}.json'
        meta={'body':body,'request_fingerprint':proposed['fingerprint']}
        if path.exists():
            if json.loads(path.read_text())!=meta:raise ValueError('existing job execution metadata differs')
        else:atomic_json(path,meta)
        return proposed
    def validated_request(self,job):
        job=job_id(job);meta=json.loads((self.directory/'requests'/f'{job}.json').read_text())
        body=meta['body'];row=self.store.get(job)
        request={k:body[k] for k in ('project','host','tool','checkout','goal','scope')}
        normalized=self.store.request(**request)
        if digest(normalized)!=row['fingerprint'] or meta['request_fingerprint']!=row['fingerprint']:raise ValueError('execution metadata changed; fresh owner proposal required')
        expected=body['scope'].rsplit('\nExecution digest: ',1)[-1]
        if expected!=digest({k:v for k,v in body.items() if k!='scope'}):raise ValueError('execution prompt/checks changed')
        if body['host']!=self.host or str(Path(body['checkout']).resolve(strict=True))!=body['checkout']:raise ValueError('host/checkout identity changed')
        return body
    def approve(self,job,owner_identity,fingerprint,policy_hash,reason,*,task_exception=False):
        if not isinstance(owner_identity,str) or not owner_identity.strip():raise ValueError('verified owner identity required')
        row=self.store.get(job);self.validated_request(job)
        if row['fingerprint']!=fingerprint or self.store.policy_hash!=policy_hash:raise ValueError('stale displayed task/policy; refresh before approval')
        self.store.approve(job,owner_reply_receipt='dashboard-owner:'+owner_identity,reason=reason,task_exception=task_exception)
    def launch(self,job,settings):
        body=self.validated_request(job)
        self.store.claim(job)
        unit='hermes-work-'+job_id(job)
        command=['/usr/bin/systemd-run','--user','--unit',unit,'--property=KillMode=control-group',
            '--property=TimeoutStopSec=10s','--property=RuntimeMaxSec='+str(settings['timeout_seconds']+30)+'s',
            '--property=MemoryMax='+settings['worker_memory_max'],'--property=TasksMax=256',
            '/usr/bin/python3',str(ROOT/'bin/workspace.py'),'_run',job]
        result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
        if result.returncode:
            evidence=self.directory/'launch-failures'/f'{job}.json'
            atomic_json(evidence,{'at':now(),'unit_started':False,'exit_code':result.returncode})
            self.store.finish(job,'failed',str(evidence));raise RuntimeError('owned worker service launch failed; ask owner')
        return {'job_id':job,'unit':unit,'state':self.store.get(job)['state']}
    def cancel(self,job):
        row=self.store.get(job);unit='hermes-work-'+job_id(job)
        if row['state'] not in ('queued','starting','running'):raise ValueError('job not active')
        result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','--user','stop',unit],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
        if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('owned unit stop failed; lease retained')
        return self.recover(job,cancelled=True)
    def recover(self,job,*,cancelled=False):
        row=self.store.get(job);unit='hermes-work-'+job_id(job)
        if row['state'] not in ('queued','starting','running'):return {'job_id':job,'state':row['state']}
        result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','--user','show',unit,'--property=ActiveState','--property=SubState','--property=ControlGroup','--property=MainPID'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
        values=dict(line.split('=',1) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if '=' in line)
        if values.get('ActiveState') not in ('inactive','failed') or values.get('MainPID')!='0':raise RuntimeError('exit not proven; active/unknown job lease retained')
        cgroup=values.get('ControlGroup')
        if cgroup:
            procs=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/cgroup.lstrip('/')/'cgroup.procs'
            if procs.exists() and procs.read_text().strip():raise RuntimeError('owned descendants remain; lease retained')
        evidence=self.directory/'recoveries'/f'{job}.json'
        atomic_json(evidence,{'at':now(),'owned_unit':unit,'unit_state':values,'process_exit_proven':True,'interrupted':not cancelled})
        self.store.finish(job,'cancelled' if cancelled else 'failed',str(evidence))
        return {'job_id':job,'state':self.store.get(job)['state'],'evidence':str(evidence)}
    def execute(self,job,settings):
        body=self.validated_request(job);self.store.prepare_start(job)
        evidence=self.directory/'runs'/job
        env=child_environment(body['tool'],os.environ)
        paths=settings['paths'];tool=body['tool']
        try:
            if tool in ('codex','claude_code'):
                cmd=[paths[tool],'login','status'] if tool=='codex' else [paths[tool],'auth','status','--json']
                auth=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
                if tool=='codex':valid=auth.returncode==0 and 'chatgpt' in (auth.stdout+auth.stderr).lower()
                else:
                    details=json.loads(auth.stdout);valid=details.get('loggedIn') is True and details.get('authMethod')=='claude.ai'
                if not valid:raise ValueError('subscription login not verified; ask owner')
            else:
                # Attach to the existing authenticated server, never start another.
                pid=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','--user','show','opencode-mobile.service','--property=MainPID','--value'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=10).stdout.strip()
                if not pid.isdigit() or pid=='0':raise ValueError('existing OpenCode singleton unavailable')
                existing=dict(part.split(b'=',1) for part in Path('/proc/'+pid+'/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in part)
                for name in ('OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME','OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD'):
                    if name.encode() in existing:env[name]=existing[name.encode()].decode()
            model=body.get('model') or settings.get('models',{}).get(tool)
            command=worker_command(tool,paths,body['checkout'],session=body.get('resume_session'),model=model,attach=settings.get('opencode_attach'),effort=body.get('effort'),max_turns=body.get('max_turns'),minimal=body.get('minimal_test',False))
            if tool=='opencode':
                command=['/usr/bin/python3',str(ROOT/'bin/opencode_worker.py'),'--base',settings['opencode_attach'],'--checkout',body['checkout'],'--model',model]
                if body.get('resume_session'):command+=['--session',body['resume_session']]
            seen=False
            def session_found(session):
                nonlocal seen
                if not seen:self.store.mark_running(job,session);seen=True
            outcome=execute_owned(command,body['checkout'],evidence,env,tool,timeout=settings['timeout_seconds'],on_session=session_found,prompt=body['prompt'])
            verified=verify_artifacts(body['checkout'],body['checks']) if body['checks'] else False
            success=outcome['exit_code']==0 and not any(outcome.get(k) for k in ('reported_error','timed_out','cancelled')) and verified and seen
            outcome['artifact_checks_passed']=verified;outcome['completion_verified']=success
            outcome['validation_pending']=not body['checks'] and outcome['exit_code']==0
            outcome['no_provider_fallback']=True;atomic_json(evidence/'result.json',outcome)
            state='cancelled' if outcome['cancelled'] else ('completed' if success else 'failed')
            self.store.finish(job,state,str(evidence/'result.json'));return outcome
        except BaseException as error:
            failure=self.directory/'failures'/f'{job}.json'
            atomic_json(failure,{'at':now(),'error_type':type(error).__name__,'ask_owner':True,'no_provider_fallback':True})
            if self.store.get(job)['state'] in ('starting','running'):self.store.finish(job,'failed',str(failure))
            raise

def configured():
    settings=json.loads((ROOT/'settings/runtime.json').read_text());policy=json.loads((ROOT/'settings/worker-policy.json').read_text())
    host='blackwall' if ROOT==Path.home()/'opt/cloud/hermes' else 'arch'
    return Workspace(JOBS,policy,host),settings

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('action',choices=['propose','status','launch','cancel','recover','_run']);parser.add_argument('job');parser.add_argument('--request')
    args=parser.parse_args();w,settings=configured();job=job_id(args.job)
    if args.action=='propose':result=w.propose(job,json.loads(Path(args.request).read_text()))
    elif args.action=='status':result=w.store.get(job)
    elif args.action=='launch':result=w.launch(job,settings)
    elif args.action=='cancel':result=w.cancel(job)
    elif args.action=='recover':result=w.recover(job)
    else:result=w.execute(job,settings)
    # Never print prompt or raw worker logs.
    if args.action=='status':result={k:result[k] for k in ('id','state','request','fingerprint','session','evidence')}
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception as error:print(json.dumps({'error_type':type(error).__name__,'ask_owner':True}),file=sys.stderr);raise SystemExit(1)
"""Owned worker process boundary; policy approval lives in worker_jobs/dashboard."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,signal,subprocess,tempfile,time

BILLED_OVERRIDES={'OPENAI_API_KEY','OPENAI_BASE_URL','OPENAI_API_BASE','OPENAI_ORG_ID','OPENAI_PROJECT_ID',
 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN','ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL','ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS',
 'CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN','CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR','CODEX_API_KEY',
 'CODEX_HOME','CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR','CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK','CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX',
 'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY','AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK','ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY'}

def now():return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def atomic_json(path,value):
    path=Path(path);path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    fd,name=tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent,prefix='.workspace-')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2);f.write('\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
        os.replace(name,path)
    finally:Path(name).unlink(missing_ok=True)

def child_environment(tool,environment):
    if tool not in ('codex','claude_code','opencode'):raise ValueError('unknown worker')
    env=dict(environment)
    if tool in ('codex','claude_code'):
        for key in list(env):
            if key in BILLED_OVERRIDES or key.startswith(('AZURE_OPENAI_','ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_','OPENAI_API_KEY_')):env.pop(key)
    env['NO_COLOR']='1';env['TERM']='dumb'
    return env

def native_session(tool,event):
    if not isinstance(event,dict):return None
    if tool=='codex' and event.get('type')=='thread.started':return event.get('thread_id')
    if tool=='claude_code' and event.get('type') in ('system','result'):return event.get('session_id')
    if tool=='opencode' and event.get('type') not in ('error',):return event.get('sessionID')
    return None

def failure_category(text):
    lower=text.lower()
    if any(x in lower for x in ('usage limit','rate limit','quota','billing_not_configured','insufficient_quota','payment required')):return 'quota_or_billing'
    if any(x in lower for x in ('unauthorized','authentication','login required','not logged in','invalid api key','expired token')):return 'authentication'
    return 'worker_error'

def verify_artifacts(cwd,checks):
    root=Path(cwd).resolve()
    if not checks:return False
    for check in checks:
        relative=Path(check['path'])
        if relative.is_absolute() or '..' in relative.parts or not relative.parts:raise ValueError('relative contained artifact required')
        path=root/relative
        for part in [path,*path.parents]:
            if part==root:break
            if part.is_symlink():raise ValueError('artifact must not traverse symlinks')
        path.resolve().relative_to(root)
        if not path.is_file():return False
        if 'text' in check:
            if path.read_text()!=check['text']:return False
        elif 'sha256' in check:
            if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=check['sha256']:return False
        else:raise ValueError('artifact text/hash acceptance required')
    return True

def execute_owned(argv,cwd,run_dir,env,tool,*,timeout=1800,on_session=None,prompt=None):
    """Supervised new process group; run_dir must be exclusive for this attempt.

    Production additionally places the whole supervisor/descendants in one systemd
    cgroup. A killed supervisor leaves its DB lease until unit recovery proves exit.
    """
    run_dir=Path(run_dir);run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    cwd=Path(cwd).resolve(strict=True)
    state={'started_at':now(),'session_id':None,'exit_code':None,'timed_out':False,'cancelled':False}
    child=None;old_handler=None
    def stop_group():
        if child is None:return
        try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
        except ProcessLookupError:return
        try:child.wait(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:pass
            child.wait(timeout=2)
        # Parent can exit before a descendant; always signal the owned group again.
        try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:pass
    def cancelled(signum,frame):
        state['cancelled']=True;stop_group()
    try:
        if __import__('threading').current_thread() is __import__('threading').main_thread():
            old_handler=signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,cancelled)
        if prompt is not None:
            fd=os.open(run_dir/'prompt.txt',os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
            with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:f.write(prompt)
        with os.fdopen(os.open(run_dir/'stdout.jsonl',os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600),'wb') as stdout, \
             os.fdopen(os.open(run_dir/'stderr.log',os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600),'wb') as stderr:
            with (run_dir/'prompt.txt').open('rb') if prompt is not None else open(os.devnull,'rb') as stdin:
                child=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdin=stdin,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,start_new_session=True)
            state['pid']=child.pid
            try:state['process_start_ticks']=Path(f'/proc/{child.pid}/stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]
            except FileNotFoundError:state['process_start_ticks']=None
            atomic_json(run_dir/'process.json',state)
            deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout;observed=None;position=0
            while child.poll() is None:
                if time.monotonic()>=deadline:state['timed_out']=True;stop_group();break
                with (run_dir/'stdout.jsonl').open('r',errors='replace') as stream:
                    stream.seek(position)
                    while True:
                        start=stream.tell();line=stream.readline()
                        if not line:break
                        if not line.endswith('\n'):stream.seek(start);break
                        try:event=json.loads(line)
                        except ValueError:continue
                        session=native_session(tool,event)
                        if isinstance(session,str) and session and session!=observed:
                            observed=session;state['session_id']=session
                            if on_session:on_session(session)
                    position=stream.tell()
                atomic_json(run_dir/'heartbeat.json',{'at':now(),'pid':child.pid})
                time.sleep(.05)
            state['exit_code']=child.wait()
        reported_error=False
        for line in (run_dir/'stdout.jsonl').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
            try:event=json.loads(line)
            except ValueError:continue
            if isinstance(event,dict) and (event.get('type') in ('error','turn.failed') or event.get('is_error') is True):reported_error=True
            session=native_session(tool,event)
            if isinstance(session,str) and session:
                state['session_id']=session
                if on_session and session!=observed:on_session(session);observed=session
        state['reported_error']=reported_error
        if state['exit_code'] or state['timed_out'] or state['cancelled'] or reported_error:
            state['failure_category']=failure_category((run_dir/'stderr.log').read_text(errors='replace')+(run_dir/'stdout.jsonl').read_text(errors='replace'))
        state['finished_at']=now();atomic_json(run_dir/'result.json',state)
        return state
    finally:
        if child and child.poll() is None:stop_group()
        if old_handler is not None:signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,old_handler)

def worker_command(tool,paths,checkout,*,session=None,model=None,attach=None,effort=None,max_turns=None,minimal=False):
    if tool=='codex':
        args=[paths[tool],'exec']+(['resume',session] if session else [])
        args+=['--json','--skip-git-repo-check','--ignore-user-config','--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox',
               '-c','forced_login_method="chatgpt"','-c','model_provider="openai"']
        if model:args+=['-m',model]
        return args
    if tool=='claude_code':
        args=[paths[tool],'-p','--output-format','stream-json','--verbose','--dangerously-skip-permissions','--setting-sources','']
        if session:args+=['--resume',session]
        if model:args+=['--model',model]
        if effort:
            if effort not in ('low','medium','high'):raise ValueError('unsupported effort')
            args+=['--effort',effort]
        if max_turns is not None:
            if type(max_turns) is not int or not 1<=max_turns<=20:raise ValueError('bounded turn cap required')
            args+=['--max-turns',str(max_turns)]
        if minimal:args+=['--strict-mcp-config','--mcp-config','{"mcpServers":{}}','--disable-slash-commands',
            '--settings','{"alwaysThinkingEnabled":false,"ultracode":false}',
            '--system-prompt','Perform only the requested disposable file test. Never delegate, commit or do unrelated work.']
        return args
    if tool=='opencode':
        if not attach or not attach.startswith('http://127.0.0.1:'):raise ValueError('existing loopback singleton required')
        args=[paths[tool],'run','--attach',attach,'--dir',str(checkout),'--format','json','--model',model,'--auto']
        if session:args+=['--session',session]
        return args
    raise ValueError('unsupported worker')
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Supported HTTP attach to existing OpenCode; never creates a server process."""
import argparse,base64,json,os,sys,urllib.error,urllib.parse,urllib.request

def turn(base,checkout,prompt,model,username,password,*,session=None):
    parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(base)
    if parsed.scheme!='http' or parsed.hostname!='127.0.0.1' or parsed.path not in ('','/'):raise ValueError('existing loopback singleton required')
    provider,model_id=model.split('/',1)
    if provider!='meta-uchaprimary' or model_id!='muse-spark-1.3-contributor':raise ValueError('owner-approved Spark route required')
    headers={'Authorization':'Basic '+base64.b64encode((username+':'+password).encode()).decode(),
             'Content-Type':'application/json','x-opencode-directory':checkout}
    query='?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'directory':checkout})
    def request(path,body):
        req=urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip('/')+path+query,data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers=headers)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=1200) as response:return json.load(response)
    if not session:
        session=request('/session',{'title':'Hermes supervised workspace task','permission':[{'permission':'*','pattern':'*','action':'allow'}]})['id']
    if not isinstance(session,str) or not session.startswith('ses_') or not all(x.isalnum() or x=='_' for x in session):raise ValueError('valid native session required')
    print(json.dumps({'type':'step_start','sessionID':session}),flush=True)
    result=request('/session/'+session+'/message',{'model':{'providerID':provider,'modelID':model_id},'parts':[{'type':'text','text':prompt}]})
    info=result.get('info',{})
    if not isinstance(info,dict) or info.get('error'):
        print(json.dumps({'type':'error','sessionID':session,'error_type':(info.get('error') or {}).get('name','OpenCodeError')}),flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError('native OpenCode turn failed; ask owner')
    for part in result.get('parts',[]):print(json.dumps({'type':part.get('type','part'),'sessionID':session,'part':part}),flush=True)
    print(json.dumps({'type':'step_finish','sessionID':session,'finish':info.get('finish')}),flush=True)
    return {'session_id':session,'finish':info.get('finish')}

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--base',required=True);parser.add_argument('--checkout',required=True);parser.add_argument('--model',required=True);parser.add_argument('--session');args=parser.parse_args()
    turn(args.base,args.checkout,sys.stdin.read(),args.model,os.environ.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME','opencode'),os.environ.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD',''),session=args.session)
if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception as error:
        print(json.dumps({'type':'error','error_type':type(error).__name__,'ask_owner':True}),flush=True);raise SystemExit(1)
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Explicit, provenance-preserving context index. Never crawls the whole workspace."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,re,sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

CONTEXTS={'work','coding','research','personal','cooking','infrastructure'}
[CONSERVATIVE CREDENTIAL-SHAPED LINE WITHHELD]

class KnowledgeIndex:
    def __init__(self,path,root):
        self.path=Path(path);self.root=Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
        if self.path.is_symlink():raise ValueError('index symlink refused')
        self.path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        self.path.parent.chmod(0o700)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db:
            db.execute('CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents USING fts5(path UNINDEXED, context UNINDEXED, sha256 UNINDEXED, content)');db.commit()
        self.path.chmod(0o600)
    def refresh(self,sources):
        prepared=[]
        for source in sources:
            path=Path(source['path']);context=source['context']
            if context not in CONTEXTS:raise ValueError('unknown knowledge context')
            if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or any(p in ('private','runtime','.git') or p.startswith('.env') for p in path.parts) or path.suffix in ('.key','.db','.sqlite'):raise ValueError('source is not an approved document')
            actual=self.root/path
            for part in [actual,*actual.parents]:
                if part==self.root:break
                if part.is_symlink():raise ValueError('symlink source refused')
            actual.resolve().relative_to(self.root)
            if not actual.exists():continue
            if not actual.is_file() or actual.stat().st_size>1_000_000:raise ValueError('bounded regular text source required')
            content=actual.read_text()
            if SECRET.search(content):raise ValueError('credential-shaped content cannot enter knowledge index')
            prepared.append((str(path),context,hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest(),content))
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db:
            with db:
                db.execute('DELETE FROM documents');db.executemany('INSERT INTO documents VALUES(?,?,?,?)',prepared)
        return {'indexed_sources':len(prepared),'contexts':sorted({x[1] for x in prepared})}
    def search(self,query,context,limit=8):
        if context not in CONTEXTS:raise ValueError('explicit known context required')
        if type(limit) is not int or not 1<=limit<=30:raise ValueError('bounded search limit required')
        tokens=re.findall(r'[^\W_]+',query,flags=re.UNICODE)
        if not tokens:return []
        expression=' AND '.join('"'+token+'"' for token in tokens[:30])
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)) as db:
            rows=db.execute("SELECT path,context,sha256,snippet(documents,3,'[',']',' … ',32) FROM documents WHERE documents MATCH ? AND context=? ORDER BY rank LIMIT ?",(expression,context,limit)).fetchall()
        return [dict(zip(('path','context','sha256','excerpt'),row)) for row in rows]

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('action',choices=['refresh','search']);parser.add_argument('query',nargs='?',default='');parser.add_argument('--context',default='infrastructure');args=parser.parse_args()
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];index=KnowledgeIndex(Path.home()/'.hermes/workspace-knowledge/index.db',root)
    out=index.refresh(json.loads((root/'settings/knowledge-sources.json').read_text())) if args.action=='refresh' else index.search(args.query,args.context)
    print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reviewed decision examples and category uncertainty; never promotes routing."""
import argparse,json,math,os,sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path
from worker_jobs import digest
from worker_runtime import now
from workspace_knowledge import SECRET

FIELDS={'project','category','tool','host','recommendation','owner_choice','policy_violation','outcome','held_out','receipt','reason'}

def zero_error_bound(n):return 1-math.exp(math.log(.05)/n) if n>0 else None

class Examples:
    def __init__(self,path):
        self.path=Path(path)
        if self.path.is_symlink():raise ValueError('examples symlink refused')
        self.path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True);self.path.parent.chmod(0o700)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db:
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS examples(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, at TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)');db.commit()
        self.path.chmod(0o600)
    def append(self,sample_id,data):
        if set(data)!=FIELDS or not sample_id or any(not isinstance(data[k],str) or not data[k].strip() for k in FIELDS-{'held_out','policy_violation'}):raise ValueError('complete reviewed decision receipt required')
        if type(data['held_out']) is not bool or type(data['policy_violation']) is not bool:raise ValueError('explicit evaluation flags required')
        if data['tool'] not in ('opencode','codex','claude_code') or data['host'] not in ('blackwall','arch') or data['outcome'] not in ('passed','failed','cancelled','limited'):raise ValueError('known route/outcome required')
        raw=json.dumps(data,sort_keys=True)
        if len(raw)>10000 or SECRET.search(raw):raise ValueError('bounded credential-free decision metadata required')
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path,timeout=10)) as db:
            with db:
                old=db.execute('SELECT fingerprint FROM examples WHERE id=?',(sample_id,)).fetchone()
                if old:
                    if old[0]!=digest(data):raise ValueError('reviewed decision is immutable')
                else:db.execute('INSERT INTO examples VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(sample_id,now(),digest(data),raw))
    def scorecard(self):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True)) as db:rows=[json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute('SELECT data FROM examples ORDER BY at')]
        categories={}
        for row in rows:
            category=categories.setdefault(row['category'],{'count':0,'held_out_count':0,'policy_violations':0,'recommendation_agreements':0,'successful_tasks':0})
            category['count']+=1;category['held_out_count']+=int(row['held_out']);category['policy_violations']+=int(row['policy_violation'])
            category['recommendation_agreements']+=int(row['recommendation']==row['owner_choice']);category['successful_tasks']+=int(row['outcome']=='passed')
        for category in categories.values():category['zero_error_upper_bound_95']=zero_error_bound(category['count']) if not category['policy_violations'] else None
        return {'routing_mode':'ask','autonomy_ready':False,'automatic_promotion':False,'independent_outcomes':len(rows),'categories':categories,
                'limits':'Counts are reviewed examples, not proven independent trials. Coverage, held-out results, months of observation and explicit owner choice are still required.'}

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('action',choices=['scorecard','append']);parser.add_argument('--id');parser.add_argument('--file');args=parser.parse_args()
    store=Examples(Path.home()/'.hermes/workspace-learning/examples.db')
    if args.action=='append':store.append(args.id,json.loads(Path(args.file).read_text()))
    print(json.dumps(store.scorecard(),indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Report-only Pixel TLS-ADB port receiver on the existing WireGuard address."""
import hashlib,hmac,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,HTTPServer
from worker_runtime import atomic_json,now

PEER='10.99.0.3'
ADB=str(Path.home()/'Android/platform-tools/adb')

def validate_report(source,authorization,body,token):
    if source!=PEER or not hmac.compare_digest(authorization,'Bearer '+token):raise PermissionError('report-only authorization required')
    if not isinstance(body,dict) or set(body)!={'port'} or type(body['port']) is not int or not 1<=body['port']<=65535:raise ValueError('single integer TLS port required')
    return body['port']

def reconnect(port,identity_hash,*,runner=subprocess.run):
    if type(port) is not int or not 1<=port<=65535:raise ValueError('invalid port')
    serial=f'{PEER}:{port}';env=dict(os.environ,PATH=os.environ.get('PATH','')+':'+str(Path(ADB).parent))
    connected=runner([ADB,'connect',serial],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
    if connected.returncode or not ('connected to '+serial in connected.stdout or 'already connected to '+serial in connected.stdout):return False
    identity=runner([ADB,'-s',serial,'shell','getprop','ro.serialno'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
    verified=identity.returncode==0 and bool(identity.stdout.strip()) and hmac.compare_digest(hashlib.sha256(identity.stdout.strip().encode()).hexdigest(),identity_hash)
    if not verified:runner([ADB,'disconnect',serial],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
    return verified

def main():
    token=os.environ['PIXEL_ADB_REPORT_TOKEN'];identity=os.environ['PIXEL_ADB_IDENTITY_HASH']
    if len(token)<40 or len(identity)!=64:raise ValueError('private scoped credential and pinned identity required')
    directory=Path.home()/'.hermes/mobile-adb';directory.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True);directory.chmod(0o700)
    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        last_attempt=0
        def log_message(self,*args):pass
        def answer(self,status,body):
            raw=json.dumps(body).encode();self.send_response(status);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json');self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(raw)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(raw)
        def do_POST(self):
            if self.path!='/v1/pixel/port':self.answer(404,{'ok':False});return
            try:
                # Authenticate before parsing any caller-supplied body.
                if self.client_address[0]!=PEER or not hmac.compare_digest(self.headers.get('Authorization',''),'Bearer '+token):raise PermissionError()
                size=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
                if not 1<=size<=128:raise ValueError()
                port=validate_report(self.client_address[0],self.headers.get('Authorization',''),json.loads(self.rfile.read(size)),token)
                if time.monotonic()-Handler.last_attempt<5:self.answer(429,{'ok':False,'retry':True});return
                Handler.last_attempt=time.monotonic()
                try:verified=reconnect(port,identity)
                except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired,OSError):verified=False
                result={'reported_at':now(),'port':port,'identity_verified':verified,'connected':verified}
                atomic_json(directory/'last-report.json',result);self.answer(200,{'ok':True,'connected':verified})
            except PermissionError:self.answer(403,{'ok':False})
            except (ValueError,TypeError):self.answer(400,{'ok':False})
        def setup(self):
            super().setup();self.connection.settimeout(20)
    HTTPServer(('10.99.0.2',19191),Handler).serve_forever()

if __name__=='__main__':main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Supported HTTP attach to existing OpenCode; never creates a server process."""
import argparse,base64,json,os,sys,time,urllib.error,urllib.parse,urllib.request

def ensure_idle(base,checkout,session,username,password,*,abort=False):
    """Prove native server execution ended; client/cgroup exit is insufficient."""
    if urllib.parse.urlsplit(base).hostname!='127.0.0.1' or not base.startswith('http://'):raise ValueError('loopback singleton required')
    if not isinstance(session,str) or not session.startswith('ses_') or not all(x.isalnum() or x=='_' for x in session):raise ValueError('owned native session required')
    headers={'Authorization':'Basic '+base64.b64encode((username+':'+password).encode()).decode(),'Content-Type':'application/json','x-opencode-directory':checkout}
    query='?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'directory':checkout})
    def request(path,body=None):
        req=urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip('/')+path+query,headers=headers,data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode())
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2) as r:return json.load(r)
    native=request('/session/'+session)
    if native.get('id')!=session or native.get('directory')!=checkout:raise ValueError('native checkout/session ownership mismatch')
    aborted=False;deadline=time.monotonic()+5
    if abort:
        if request('/session/'+session+'/abort',{}) is not True:raise RuntimeError('native abort not acknowledged')
        aborted=True
    while True:
        statuses=request('/session/status')
        if not isinstance(statuses,dict):raise RuntimeError('native execution state unknown')
        status=statuses.get(session,{'type':'idle'})
        if not isinstance(status,dict):raise RuntimeError('native execution state malformed')
        if status.get('type')=='idle':return {'engine_exit_proven':True,'engine_aborted':aborted}
        if status.get('type') not in ('busy','retry'):raise RuntimeError('native execution state unknown')
        if not aborted:
            if request('/session/'+session+'/abort',{}) is not True:raise RuntimeError('native abort not acknowledged')
            aborted=True
        if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise RuntimeError('native execution still active; retain lease')
        time.sleep(.05)

def turn(base,checkout,prompt,model,username,password,*,session=None):
    parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(base)
    if parsed.scheme!='http' or parsed.hostname!='127.0.0.1' or parsed.path not in ('','/'):raise ValueError('existing loopback singleton required')
    provider,model_id=model.split('/',1)
    if provider!='meta-uchaprimary' or model_id!='muse-spark-1.3-contributor':raise ValueError('owner-approved Spark route required')
    headers={'Authorization':'Basic '+base64.b64encode((username+':'+password).encode()).decode(),
             'Content-Type':'application/json','x-opencode-directory':checkout}
    query='?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'directory':checkout})
    def request(path,body):
        req=urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip('/')+path+query,data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers=headers)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=1200) as response:return json.load(response)
    if not session:
        session=request('/session',{'title':'Hermes supervised workspace task','permission':[{'permission':'*','pattern':'*','action':'allow'}]})['id']
    if not isinstance(session,str) or not session.startswith('ses_') or not all(x.isalnum() or x=='_' for x in session):raise ValueError('valid native session required')
    print(json.dumps({'type':'step_start','sessionID':session}),flush=True)
    result=request('/session/'+session+'/message',{'model':{'providerID':provider,'modelID':model_id},'parts':[{'type':'text','text':prompt}]})
    info=result.get('info',{})
    if not isinstance(info,dict) or info.get('error'):
        print(json.dumps({'type':'error','sessionID':session,'error_type':(info.get('error') or {}).get('name','OpenCodeError')}),flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError('native OpenCode turn failed; ask owner')
    for part in result.get('parts',[]):print(json.dumps({'type':part.get('type','part'),'sessionID':session,'part':part}),flush=True)
    print(json.dumps({'type':'step_finish','sessionID':session,'finish':info.get('finish')}),flush=True)
    return {'session_id':session,'finish':info.get('finish')}

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--base',required=True);parser.add_argument('--checkout',required=True);parser.add_argument('--model',required=True);parser.add_argument('--session');args=parser.parse_args()
    turn(args.base,args.checkout,sys.stdin.read(),args.model,os.environ.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME','opencode'),os.environ.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD',''),session=args.session)
if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception as error:
        print(json.dumps({'type':'error','error_type':type(error).__name__,'ask_owner':True}),flush=True);raise SystemExit(1)

"""Blackwall-owned ask-first jobs. CLI proposes/status; owner approval is private API."""
import argparse,json,os,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from worker_jobs import JobStore,digest
from worker_runtime import atomic_json,child_environment,execute_owned,now,verify_artifacts,worker_command

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
JOBS=Path.home()/'.hermes/workspace-jobs'

def opencode_environment(env):
    env=dict(env)
    pid=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','--user','show','opencode-mobile.service','--property=MainPID','--value'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=10).stdout.strip()
    if not pid.isdigit() or pid=='0':raise ValueError('existing OpenCode singleton unavailable')
    existing=dict(part.split(b'=',1) for part in Path('/proc/'+pid+'/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in part)
    for name in ('OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME','OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD'):
        if name.encode() in existing:env[name]=existing[name.encode()].decode()
    return env

def settle_opencode(settings,body,session,env,*,abort=False):
    from opencode_worker import ensure_idle
    return ensure_idle(settings['opencode_attach'],body['checkout'],session,env.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME','opencode'),env.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD',''),abort=abort)

def job_id(value):
    if not isinstance(value,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,79}',value):raise ValueError('invalid stable job id')
    return value

class Workspace:
    def __init__(self,directory,policy,host):
        self.directory=Path(directory);self.host=host;self.store=JobStore(self.directory/'jobs.db',policy)
        (self.directory/'requests').mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
    def propose(self,job,body):
        job=job_id(job);body=dict(body)
        if body.get('host')!=self.host:raise ValueError('selected host unavailable through this executor; no implicit migration')
        original=Path(body['checkout']);checkout=original.resolve(strict=True)
        if str(original)!=str(checkout) or not checkout.is_dir():raise ValueError('resolve canonical selected-host checkout before proposal')
        if not isinstance(body.get('prompt'),str) or not body['prompt'].strip() or len(body['prompt'])>100000:raise ValueError('bounded prompt required')
        if not isinstance(body.get('checks',[]),list):raise ValueError('artifact checks must be a list')
        body['checks']=body.get('checks',[])
        if body['tool']=='opencode' and body.get('model',self.store.policy['worker_auth']['opencode']['model'])!=self.store.policy['worker_auth']['opencode']['model']:
            raise ValueError('OpenCode provider change requires owner policy decision')
        body['scope']=body['scope']+'\nExecution digest: '+digest({k:v for k,v in body.items() if k!='scope'})
        request={k:body[k] for k in ('project','host','tool','checkout','goal','scope')}
        proposed=self.store.propose(job,**request)
        path=self.directory/'requests'/f'{job}.json'
        meta={'body':body,'request_fingerprint':proposed['fingerprint']}
        if path.exists():
            if json.loads(path.read_text())!=meta:raise ValueError('existing job execution metadata differs')
        else:atomic_json(path,meta)
        return proposed
    def validated_request(self,job):
        job=job_id(job);meta=json.loads((self.directory/'requests'/f'{job}.json').read_text())
        body=meta['body'];row=self.store.get(job)
        request={k:body[k] for k in ('project','host','tool','checkout','goal','scope')}
        normalized=self.store.request(**request)
        if digest(normalized)!=row['fingerprint'] or meta['request_fingerprint']!=row['fingerprint']:raise ValueError('execution metadata changed; fresh owner proposal required')
        expected=body['scope'].rsplit('\nExecution digest: ',1)[-1]
        if expected!=digest({k:v for k,v in body.items() if k!='scope'}):raise ValueError('execution prompt/checks changed')
        if body['host']!=self.host or str(Path(body['checkout']).resolve(strict=True))!=body['checkout']:raise ValueError('host/checkout identity changed')
        return body
    def approve(self,job,owner_identity,fingerprint,policy_hash,reason,*,task_exception=False):
        if not isinstance(owner_identity,str) or not owner_identity.strip():raise ValueError('verified owner identity required')
        row=self.store.get(job);self.validated_request(job)
        if row['fingerprint']!=fingerprint or self.store.policy_hash!=policy_hash:raise ValueError('stale displayed task/policy; refresh before approval')
        self.store.approve(job,owner_reply_receipt='dashboard-owner:'+owner_identity,reason=reason,task_exception=task_exception)
    def launch(self,job,settings):
        body=self.validated_request(job)
        self.store.claim(job)
        unit='hermes-work-'+job_id(job)
        command=['/usr/bin/systemd-run','--user','--unit',unit,'--property=KillMode=control-group',
            '--property=TimeoutStopSec=10s','--property=RuntimeMaxSec='+str(settings['timeout_seconds']+30)+'s',
            '--property=MemoryMax='+settings['worker_memory_max'],'--property=TasksMax=256',
            '/usr/bin/python3',str(ROOT/'bin/workspace.py'),'_run',job]
        result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
        if result.returncode:
            evidence=self.directory/'launch-failures'/f'{job}.json'
            atomic_json(evidence,{'at':now(),'unit_started':False,'exit_code':result.returncode})
            self.store.finish(job,'failed',str(evidence));raise RuntimeError('owned worker service launch failed; ask owner')
        return {'job_id':job,'unit':unit,'state':self.store.get(job)['state']}
    def cancel(self,job):
        row=self.store.get(job);unit='hermes-work-'+job_id(job)
        if row['state'] not in ('queued','starting','running'):raise ValueError('job not active')
        result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','--user','stop',unit],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
        if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('owned unit stop failed; lease retained')
        return self.recover(job,cancelled=True)
    def recover(self,job,*,cancelled=False):
        row=self.store.get(job);unit='hermes-work-'+job_id(job)
        if row['state'] not in ('queued','starting','running'):return {'job_id':job,'state':row['state']}
        result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','--user','show',unit,'--property=ActiveState','--property=SubState','--property=ControlGroup','--property=MainPID'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
        values=dict(line.split('=',1) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if '=' in line)
        if values.get('ActiveState') not in ('inactive','failed') or values.get('MainPID')!='0':raise RuntimeError('exit not proven; active/unknown job lease retained')
        cgroup=values.get('ControlGroup')
        if cgroup:
            procs=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/cgroup.lstrip('/')/'cgroup.procs'
            if procs.exists() and procs.read_text().strip():raise RuntimeError('owned descendants remain; lease retained')
        engine={}
        body=self.validated_request(job)
        if body['tool']=='opencode':
            _,settings=configured();session=row.get('session')
            if not session:
                from worker_runtime import native_session
                log=self.directory/'runs'/job/'stdout.jsonl'
                if log.exists():
                    for line in log.open():
                        try:session=native_session('opencode',json.loads(line)) or session
                        except ValueError:pass
            if not session:raise RuntimeError('native server ownership unknown; lease retained')
            engine=settle_opencode(settings,body,session,opencode_environment(os.environ),abort=True)
        evidence=self.directory/'recoveries'/f'{job}.json'
        atomic_json(evidence,{'at':now(),'owned_unit':unit,'unit_state':values,'process_exit_proven':True,'interrupted':not cancelled,**engine})
        self.store.finish(job,'cancelled' if cancelled else 'failed',str(evidence))
        return {'job_id':job,'state':self.store.get(job)['state'],'evidence':str(evidence)}
    def execute(self,job,settings):
        body=self.validated_request(job);self.store.prepare_start(job)
        evidence=self.directory/'runs'/job
        env=child_environment(body['tool'],os.environ)
        paths=settings['paths'];tool=body['tool']
        execution_started=False
        try:
            if tool in ('codex','claude_code'):
                cmd=[paths[tool],'login','status'] if tool=='codex' else [paths[tool],'auth','status','--json']
                auth=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
                if tool=='codex':valid=auth.returncode==0 and 'chatgpt' in (auth.stdout+auth.stderr).lower()
                else:
                    details=json.loads(auth.stdout);valid=details.get('loggedIn') is True and details.get('authMethod')=='claude.ai'
                if not valid:raise ValueError('subscription login not verified; ask owner')
            else:
                # Attach to the existing authenticated server, never start another.
                env=opencode_environment(env)
            model=body.get('model') or settings.get('models',{}).get(tool)
            command=worker_command(tool,paths,body['checkout'],session=body.get('resume_session'),model=model,attach=settings.get('opencode_attach'),effort=body.get('effort'),max_turns=body.get('max_turns'),minimal=body.get('minimal_test',False))
            if tool=='opencode':
                command=['/usr/bin/python3',str(ROOT/'bin/opencode_worker.py'),'--base',settings['opencode_attach'],'--checkout',body['checkout'],'--model',model]
                if body.get('resume_session'):command+=['--session',body['resume_session']]
            seen=False;session_matches=True
            def session_found(session):
                nonlocal seen,session_matches
                if body.get('resume_session') and session!=body['resume_session']:session_matches=False
                if not seen:self.store.mark_running(job,session);seen=True
            execution_started=True
            outcome=execute_owned(command,body['checkout'],evidence,env,tool,timeout=settings['timeout_seconds'],on_session=session_found,prompt=body['prompt'])
            if tool=='opencode':outcome.update(settle_opencode(settings,body,outcome['session_id'],env,abort=bool(outcome['exit_code'] or outcome['timed_out'] or outcome['cancelled'])))
            verified=verify_artifacts(body['checkout'],body['checks']) if body['checks'] else False
            outcome['approved_resume_session_matches']=session_matches
            success=outcome['exit_code']==0 and not any(outcome.get(k) for k in ('reported_error','timed_out','cancelled','engine_aborted')) and verified and seen and session_matches
            outcome['artifact_checks_passed']=verified;outcome['completion_verified']=success
            outcome['validation_pending']=not body['checks'] and outcome['exit_code']==0
            outcome['no_provider_fallback']=True;atomic_json(evidence/'result.json',outcome)
            state='cancelled' if outcome['cancelled'] else ('completed' if success else 'failed')
            self.store.finish(job,state,str(evidence/'result.json'));return outcome
        except BaseException as error:
            failure=self.directory/'failures'/f'{job}.json'
            atomic_json(failure,{'at':now(),'error_type':type(error).__name__,'ask_owner':True,'no_provider_fallback':True})
            # After process launch an unexpected exception is not exit proof.
            # Leave ownership until recover proves cgroup AND native-engine exit.
            if not execution_started and self.store.get(job)['state'] in ('starting','running'):self.store.finish(job,'failed',str(failure))
            raise

def configured():
    settings=json.loads((ROOT/'settings/runtime.json').read_text());policy=json.loads((ROOT/'settings/worker-policy.json').read_text())
    host='blackwall' if ROOT==Path.home()/'opt/cloud/hermes' else 'arch'
    return Workspace(JOBS,policy,host),settings

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('action',choices=['propose','status','launch','cancel','recover','_run']);parser.add_argument('job');parser.add_argument('--request')
    args=parser.parse_args();w,settings=configured();job=job_id(args.job)
    if args.action=='propose':result=w.propose(job,json.loads(Path(args.request).read_text()))
    elif args.action=='status':result=w.store.get(job)
    elif args.action=='launch':result=w.launch(job,settings)
    elif args.action=='cancel':result=w.cancel(job)
    elif args.action=='recover':result=w.recover(job)
    else:result=w.execute(job,settings)
    # Never print prompt or raw worker logs.
    if args.action=='status':result={k:result[k] for k in ('id','state','request','fingerprint','session','evidence')}
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':

    def finish_owned():
        deadline=time.monotonic()+2
        while True:
            live=remaining_owned()
            if not live:return True
            for pid in live:
                try:os.kill(pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
            if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise RuntimeError('owned descendants still executing; lease must remain held')
            time.sleep(.02)
    def stop_group():
        if child is None:return
        try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
        except ProcessLookupError:return
        try:child.wait(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:pass
            child.wait(timeout=2)
        # Parent can exit before a descendant; always signal the owned group again.
        try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:pass
    def cancelled(signum,frame):

            with (run_dir/'prompt.txt').open('rb') if prompt is not None else open(os.devnull,'rb') as stdin:

            except FileNotFoundError:state['process_start_ticks']=None
            atomic_json(run_dir/'process.json',state)
            deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout;observed=None;position=0
            while child.poll() is None:
                if time.monotonic()>=deadline:state['timed_out']=True;stop_group();break
                with (run_dir/'stdout.jsonl').open('r',errors='replace') as stream:
                    stream.seek(position)
                    while True:
                        start=stream.tell();line=stream.readline()
                        if not line:break

            state['owned_process_exit_proven']=finish_owned()
        reported_error=False
        for line in (run_dir/'stdout.jsonl').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
            try:event=json.loads(line)
            except ValueError:continue
            if isinstance(event,dict) and (event.get('type') in ('error','turn.failed') or event.get('is_error') is True):reported_error=True
            session=native_session(tool,event)
            if isinstance(session,str) and session:
                state['session_id']=session
                if on_session and session!=observed:on_session(session);observed=session
        state['reported_error']=reported_error
        if state['exit_code'] or state['timed_out'] or state['cancelled'] or reported_error:
            state['failure_category']=failure_category((run_dir/'stderr.log').read_text(errors='replace')+(run_dir/'stdout.jsonl').read_text(errors='replace'))
        state['finished_at']=now();atomic_json(run_dir/'result.json',state)
        return state
    finally:
        if child and child.poll() is None:stop_group()
        if old_handler is not None:signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,old_handler)

"""Owner-only dashboard actions; never accepts identity from caller JSON/headers."""
import time

def owner_identity(session,owner,headers,*,mutation=False):
    if session is None or getattr(session,'user_id',None)!=owner['user_id'] or getattr(session,'provider',None)!=owner['provider'] or getattr(session,'expires_at',0)<=time.time():raise PermissionError('verified owner session required')
    if mutation:
        origin=headers.get('origin')
        if origin and origin!=owner['origin']:raise PermissionError('same-origin owner action required')
        if not origin and not headers.get('authorization','').lower().startswith('bearer '):raise PermissionError('cookie actions require same-origin confirmation')
    return session.user_id
"""Existing native dashboard auth owns identity. No new login/token provider."""
import asyncio,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import APIRouter,Request,HTTPException
from hermes_cli.dashboard_auth.base import Session
ROOT=Path.home()/'opt/cloud/hermes'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'bin'))
from workspace import configured,job_id
from dashboard_owner import owner_identity
router=APIRouter()

def owner(request,mutation=False):
    session=getattr(request.state,'session',None)
    if not isinstance(session,Session):raise HTTPException(403,'Sign in as the workspace owner.')
    config=json.loads((ROOT/'settings/dashboard-owner.json').read_text())
    try:return owner_identity(session,config,request.headers,mutation=mutation)
    except PermissionError:raise HTTPException(403,'Owner confirmation required.') from None

@router.get('/jobs')
def jobs(request:Request):
    owner(request);w,_=configured()
    with w.store.transaction() as db:ids=[row[0] for row in db.execute('SELECT id FROM jobs ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 40')]
    rows=[]
    for identifier in ids:
        row=w.store.get(identifier)
        # Historical failures must not hide all other jobs when their checkout
        # was intentionally removed. Approval still revalidates the live path.
        meta=json.loads((w.directory/'requests'/f'{identifier}.json').read_text());body=meta['body']
        rows.append({k:row[k] for k in ('id','state','request','fingerprint','session')} | {'prompt':body['prompt']})
    return {'jobs':rows,'policy_hash':w.store.policy_hash,'routing_mode':w.store.policy['routing_mode']}

@router.post('/jobs/{identifier}/run')
async def run_job(identifier:str,request:Request):
    identity=owner(request,True);w,settings=configured()
    if int(request.headers.get('content-length','0'))>4096:raise HTTPException(413,'Confirmation too large.')
    raw=bytearray()
    async for chunk in request.stream():
        raw.extend(chunk)
        if len(raw)>4096:raise HTTPException(413,'Confirmation too large.')
    try:
        body=json.loads(raw)
        if not isinstance(body,dict) or set(body)-{'fingerprint','policy_hash','reason','task_exception'}:raise ValueError()
        if type(body.get('task_exception',False)) is not bool:raise ValueError()
        w.approve(job_id(identifier),identity,body['fingerprint'],body['policy_hash'],body['reason'],task_exception=body.get('task_exception',False))
        return await asyncio.to_thread(w.launch,identifier,settings)
    except (ValueError,KeyError):raise HTTPException(409,'Task or policy changed. Refresh and confirm the displayed scope.') from None
    except RuntimeError:raise HTTPException(409,'Worker unavailable. Ask Hermes to check the task status.') from None

@router.post('/jobs/{identifier}/cancel')
def cancel_job(identifier:str,request:Request):
    owner(request,True);w,_=configured()
    try:return w.cancel(job_id(identifier))
    except (ValueError,RuntimeError):raise HTTPException(409,'Cancellation not verified. Hermes must inspect the retained task ownership.') from None

package dev.hermes.pixeladbhelper;
import android.app.*;
import android.content.*;
import android.net.*;
import android.net.nsd.*;
import android.os.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import org.json.JSONObject;

public class PortService extends Service {
  private NsdManager nsd;
  private NsdManager.DiscoveryListener listener;
  private final ScheduledExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
  private volatile int port=0;
  private String token;
  private volatile boolean discovering=false;
  private volatile String ownService=null;
  private final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong generation=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong(0);
  private final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean restarting=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false);
  private void status(String message){getSharedPreferences("status",0).edit().putString("message",message).apply();}
  public void onCreate(){super.onCreate();NotificationManager nm=getSystemService(NotificationManager.class);nm.createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel("adb-link","ADB connection",NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
    PendingIntent open=PendingIntent.getActivity(this,0,new Intent(this,MainActivity.class),PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
    startForeground(1,new Notification.Builder(this,"adb-link").setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_notify_sync).setContentTitle("Hermes ADB Link").setContentText("Discovering this phone's encrypted debugging port").setContentIntent(open).build());
    try{JSONObject c=new JSONObject(new String(Files.readAllBytes(new java.io.File(getFilesDir(),"config.json").toPath()),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));token=c.getString("token");if(token.length()<40)throw new Exception();}catch(Exception e){status("Configuration missing. Setup must install the report-only credential.");stopSelf();return;}
    nsd=getSystemService(NsdManager.class);
    getSharedPreferences("status",0).edit().putBoolean("enabled",true).apply();
    worker.scheduleWithFixedDelay(()->{try{if(!discovering)discover();if(port>0)report();}catch(Exception e){android.util.Log.w("HermesAdbLink","Discovery failure: "+e.getClass().getSimpleName()+": "+e.getMessage());status("Discovery paused ("+e.getClass().getSimpleName()+"); retrying automatically.");}},0,60,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
  }
  private NsdManager.DiscoveryListener freshListener(final long epoch){return new NsdManager.DiscoveryListener(){
      private boolean current(){return generation.get()==epoch && !worker.isShutdown();}
      public void onDiscoveryStarted(String t){if(current()){discovering=true;status("Discovering this phone's ADB port.");}}
      public void onDiscoveryStopped(String t){if(current())discovering=false;}
      public void onStartDiscoveryFailed(String t,int e){if(current()){discovering=false;status("Discovery unavailable. It will retry.");}}
      public void onStopDiscoveryFailed(String t,int e){if(current())discovering=false;}
      public void onServiceLost(NsdServiceInfo info){if(current() && info.getServiceName().equals(ownService)){port=0;status("Wireless debugging unavailable; waiting for its new port.");restartDiscovery();}}
      public void onServiceFound(NsdServiceInfo info){if(!current() || !info.getServiceType().contains("_adb-tls-connect._tcp"))return;
        nsd.resolveService(info,new NsdManager.ResolveListener(){
          public void onResolveFailed(NsdServiceInfo info,int error){if(current())restartDiscovery();}
          public void onServiceResolved(NsdServiceInfo found){if(current() && isOwnAddress(found.getHost()) && found.getPort()>0 && found.getPort()<=65535){ownService=found.getServiceName();port=found.getPort();worker.execute(()->report());}}
        });
      }
    };
  }
  private void restartDiscovery(){
    if(worker.isShutdown() || !restarting.compareAndSet(false,true))return;
    generation.incrementAndGet();try{nsd.stopServiceDiscovery(listener);}catch(Exception ignored){}discovering=false;
    worker.schedule(()->{restarting.set(false);if(!discovering)try{discover();}catch(Exception e){discovering=false;}},3,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
  }
  private void discover(){
    if(listener!=null)try{nsd.stopServiceDiscovery(listener);}catch(Exception ignored){}
    listener=freshListener(generation.incrementAndGet());
    NetworkRequest request=new NetworkRequest.Builder().addTransportType(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_WIFI).build();
    nsd.discoverServices("_adb-tls-connect._tcp",NsdManager.PROTOCOL_DNS_SD,request,getMainExecutor(),listener);
    discovering=true;
  }
  private boolean isOwnAddress(InetAddress candidate){if(candidate==null)return false;ConnectivityManager cm=getSystemService(ConnectivityManager.class);
    for(Network network:cm.getAllNetworks()){LinkProperties p=cm.getLinkProperties(network);if(p!=null)for(LinkAddress a:p.getLinkAddresses())if(candidate.equals(a.getAddress()))return true;}
    return false;
  }
  private void report(){int selected=port;if(selected<=0)return;HttpURLConnection c=null;
    try{c=(HttpURLConnection)new URL("http://10.99.0.2:19191/v1/pixel/port").openConnection();c.setConnectTimeout(8000);c.setReadTimeout(20000);c.setRequestMethod("POST");c.setRequestProperty("Authorization","Bearer "+token);c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type","application/json");c.setDoOutput(true);
      byte[] data=("{\"port\":"+selected+"}").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);c.setFixedLengthStreamingMode(data.length);try(java.io.OutputStream out=c.getOutputStream()){out.write(data);}int code=c.getResponseCode();
      if(code==200){JSONObject response=new JSONObject(new String(c.getInputStream().readAllBytes(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));status(response.optBoolean("connected")?"Blackwall connected. Port "+selected:"Port "+selected+" reported; Blackwall is retrying pairing verification.");}
      else if(code!=429)status("Report rejected ("+code+"). Setup needs checking.");
    }catch(Exception e){status("Port "+selected+" discovered. Waiting for WireGuard/server connectivity.");}finally{if(c!=null)c.disconnect();}
  }
  public int onStartCommand(Intent i,int flags,int startId){return START_STICKY;}
  public IBinder onBind(Intent i){return null;}
  public void onDestroy(){generation.incrementAndGet();worker.shutdownNow();if(nsd!=null && listener!=null)try{nsd.stopServiceDiscovery(listener);}catch(Exception ignored){}super.onDestroy();}
}
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Supported HTTP attach to existing OpenCode; never creates a server process."""
import argparse,base64,json,os,sys,time,urllib.error,urllib.parse,urllib.request

def ensure_idle(base,checkout,session,username,password,*,abort=False):
    """Prove native server execution ended; client/cgroup exit is insufficient."""
    if urllib.parse.urlsplit(base).hostname!='127.0.0.1' or not base.startswith('http://'):raise ValueError('loopback singleton required')
    if not isinstance(session,str) or not session.startswith('ses_') or not all(x.isalnum() or x=='_' for x in session):raise ValueError('owned native session required')
    headers={'Authorization':'Basic '+base64.b64encode((username+':'+password).encode()).decode(),'Content-Type':'application/json','x-opencode-directory':checkout}
    query='?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'directory':checkout})
    def request(path,body=None):
        req=urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip('/')+path+query,headers=headers,data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode())
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2) as r:return json.load(r)
    native=request('/session/'+session)
    if native.get('id')!=session or native.get('directory')!=checkout:raise ValueError('native checkout/session ownership mismatch')
    aborted=False;deadline=time.monotonic()+5
    if abort:
        if request('/session/'+session+'/abort',{}) is not True:raise RuntimeError('native abort not acknowledged')
        aborted=True
    while True:
        statuses=request('/session/status')
        if not isinstance(statuses,dict):raise RuntimeError('native execution state unknown')
        status=statuses.get(session,{'type':'idle'})
        if not isinstance(status,dict):raise RuntimeError('native execution state malformed')
        if status.get('type')=='idle':return {'engine_exit_proven':True,'engine_aborted':aborted}
        if status.get('type') not in ('busy','retry'):raise RuntimeError('native execution state unknown')
        if not aborted:
            if request('/session/'+session+'/abort',{}) is not True:raise RuntimeError('native abort not acknowledged')
            aborted=True
        if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise RuntimeError('native execution still active; retain lease')
        time.sleep(.05)

def turn(base,checkout,prompt,model,username,password,*,session=None):
    parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(base)
    if parsed.scheme!='http' or parsed.hostname!='127.0.0.1' or parsed.path not in ('','/'):raise ValueError('existing loopback singleton required')
    provider,model_id=model.split('/',1)
    if provider!='meta-uchaprimary' or model_id!='muse-spark-1.3-contributor':raise ValueError('owner-approved Spark route required')
    headers={'Authorization':'Basic '+base64.b64encode((username+':'+password).encode()).decode(),
             'Content-Type':'application/json','x-opencode-directory':checkout}
    query='?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'directory':checkout})
    def request(path,body):
        req=urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip('/')+path+query,data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers=headers)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=1200) as response:return json.load(response)
    if not session:
        session=request('/session',{'title':'Hermes supervised workspace task','permission':[{'permission':'*','pattern':'*','action':'allow'}]})['id']
    else:
        # Existing session context may belong to another checkout. Reject before
        # sending a prompt; a post-turn ownership check would be too late.
        native_req=urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip('/')+'/session/'+session+query,headers=headers)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(native_req,timeout=5) as response:native=json.load(response)
        if native.get('id')!=session or native.get('directory')!=checkout:raise ValueError('resumed native checkout ownership mismatch')
    if not isinstance(session,str) or not session.startswith('ses_') or not all(x.isalnum() or x=='_' for x in session):raise ValueError('valid native session required')
    print(json.dumps({'type':'step_start','sessionID':session}),flush=True)
    result=request('/session/'+session+'/message',{'model':{'providerID':provider,'modelID':model_id},'parts':[{'type':'text','text':prompt}]})
    info=result.get('info',{})
    if not isinstance(info,dict) or info.get('error'):
        print(json.dumps({'type':'error','sessionID':session,'error_type':(info.get('error') or {}).get('name','OpenCodeError')}),flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError('native OpenCode turn failed; ask owner')
    for part in result.get('parts',[]):print(json.dumps({'type':part.get('type','part'),'sessionID':session,'part':part}),flush=True)
    print(json.dumps({'type':'step_finish','sessionID':session,'finish':info.get('finish')}),flush=True)
    return {'session_id':session,'finish':info.get('finish')}

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--base',required=True);parser.add_argument('--checkout',required=True);parser.add_argument('--model',required=True);parser.add_argument('--session');args=parser.parse_args()
    turn(args.base,args.checkout,sys.stdin.read(),args.model,os.environ.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME','opencode'),os.environ.get('OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD',''),session=args.session)
if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception as error:
        print(json.dumps({'type':'error','error_type':type(error).__name__,'ask_owner':True}),flush=True);raise SystemExit(1)

# Hermes workspace operations

Blackwall is the sole production coordinator. Canonical project: `~/opt/cloud/hermes`; Arch mirror: `~/dev/cloud/hermes`. Read the canonical `docs/agent-policy.md`, `docs/status.md` and `settings/worker-policy.json` before acting. This reference does not authorize a task or change those decisions.

## Coding jobs

Use `/usr/bin/python3 ~/opt/cloud/hermes/bin/workspace.py --help` for the supported job interface. Propose a bounded task with explicit project, tool, host, canonical checkout, goal, scope, prompt and artifact checks, using a private request JSON. Proposal does not dispatch work. Record the recommendation and why; owner must confirm both tool and machine for each new job. The owner dashboard Work page is `https://hermes-relay.uchabokeria.space/workspace`.

Check `workspace.py status JOB_ID` for state, native session and evidence. Successful CLI exit alone is insufficient; completion requires native session identity, verified artifacts and process/server exit. Resume only a previously verified session from the same project, tool, host and checkout. Native sessions remain in their tools. Never start another OpenCode server. Subscription-only Claude/Codex and Spark-only OpenCode are enforced by the adapter.

Current production executor supports Blackwall. Arch placement, transfer/resource admission and automatic interrupted-job reconciliation are remaining gates; report that boundary instead of creating another production scheduler or silently moving a task.

## Phone and knowledge

Read `~/.hermes/mobile-adb/last-report.json` for the Pixel's observed TLS ADB port and verified connection. On Blackwall use absolute `~/Android/platform-tools/adb`, append that directory to PATH, and select `10.99.0.3:PORT` explicitly. Port reports depend on Wireless debugging and mobile WireGuard; preserve both transport configurations. Do not assume a stale report proves current connectivity or that discovery proves voice/reboot/doze acceptance.

`workspace_knowledge.py search QUERY --context CONTEXT` returns selected documents with provenance. Contexts include infrastructure, coding and research; no private transcript/account crawl is implied. `routing_learning.py scorecard` reports immutable reviewed examples. Examples are not proven independent trials; ask mode and explicit owner promotion remain in force.

Communication/chief-of-staff training stays last, after owner satisfaction with phone and two-host operation.

def job_id(value):
    if not isinstance(value,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,79}',value):raise ValueError('invalid stable job id')
    return value

class Workspace:
    def __init__(self,directory,policy,host):
        self.directory=Path(directory);self.host=host;self.store=JobStore(self.directory/'jobs.db',policy)
        (self.directory/'requests').mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
    def validate_resume_owner(self,body):
        session=body.get('resume_session')
        if not session:return
        if not isinstance(session,str) or len(session)>200:raise ValueError('bounded native resume handle required')
        with self.store.transaction() as db:
            rows=db.execute("SELECT request FROM jobs WHERE session=? AND state='completed'",(session,)).fetchall()
        expected={k:body[k] for k in ('host','tool','checkout')};project=self.store.canonical_project(body['project'])
        for row in rows:
            request=json.loads(row[0])
            if all(request.get(k)==v for k,v in expected.items()) and request.get('project')==project:return
        raise ValueError('resume requires previously verified native session for this exact project/tool/host/checkout; explicit import otherwise required')
    def propose(self,job,body):
        job=job_id(job);body=dict(body)
        if body.get('host')!=self.host:raise ValueError('selected host unavailable through this executor; no implicit migration')
        original=Path(body['checkout']);checkout=original.resolve(strict=True)
        if str(original)!=str(checkout) or not checkout.is_dir():raise ValueError('resolve canonical selected-host checkout before proposal')
        if not isinstance(body.get('prompt'),str) or not body['prompt'].strip() or len(body['prompt'])>100000:raise ValueError('bounded prompt required')
        if not isinstance(body.get('checks',[]),list):raise ValueError('artifact checks must be a list')
        body['checks']=body.get('checks',[])
        self.validate_resume_owner(body)
        if body['tool']=='opencode' and body.get('model',self.store.policy['worker_auth']['opencode']['model'])!=self.store.policy['worker_auth']['opencode']['model']:
            raise ValueError('OpenCode provider change requires owner policy decision')
        body['scope']=body['scope']+'\nExecution digest: '+digest({k:v for k,v in body.items() if k!='scope'})
        request={k:body[k] for k in ('project','host','tool','checkout','goal','scope')}
        proposed=self.store.propose(job,**request)
        path=self.directory/'requests'/f'{job}.json'
        meta={'body':body,'request_fingerprint':proposed['fingerprint']}
        if path.exists():
            if json.loads(path.read_text())!=meta:raise ValueError('existing job execution metadata differs')
        else:atomic_json(path,meta)
        return proposed
    def validated_request(self,job):
        job=job_id(job);meta=json.loads((self.directory/'requests'/f'{job}.json').read_text())
        body=meta['body'];row=self.store.get(job)
        request={k:body[k] for k in ('project','host','tool','checkout','goal','scope')}
        normalized=self.store.request(**request)
        if digest(normalized)!=row['fingerprint'] or meta['request_fingerprint']!=row['fingerprint']:raise ValueError('execution metadata changed; fresh owner proposal required')
        expected=body['scope'].rsplit('\nExecution digest: ',1)[-1]
        if expected!=digest({k:v for k,v in body.items() if k!='scope'}):raise ValueError('execution prompt/checks changed')
        if body['host']!=self.host or str(Path(body['checkout']).resolve(strict=True))!=body['checkout']:raise ValueError('host/checkout identity changed')
        self.validate_resume_owner(body)
        return body
    def approve(self,job,owner_identity,fingerprint,policy_hash,reason,*,task_exception=False):
        if not isinstance(owner_identity,str) or not owner_identity.strip():raise ValueError('verified owner identity required')
        row=self.store.get(job);self.validated_request(job)
        if row['fingerprint']!=fingerprint or self.store.policy_hash!=policy_hash:raise ValueError('stale displayed task/policy; refresh before approval')
        self.store.approve(job,owner_reply_receipt='dashboard-owner:'+owner_identity,reason=reason,task_exception=task_exception)
    def launch(self,job,settings):
        body=self.validated_request(job)
        self.store.claim(job)

# A025: outstanding acceptance and quota guard

Owner requests continued execution of all remaining work and a real 95% pause. docs/todo.txt holds H001–H019; original 68 IDs and A022 remain authoritative. No communications training or disruptive phone/network action is implied by this continuation.

## Quota design

Use the supported Codex app-server account/rateLimits/read without inference. Read only quota percentages/reset timestamps, not credentials, transcripts or account identifiers. At >=95% in any reported bucket, mark a durable pause gate and latest blocking reset +60 seconds. Missing/malformed/resetless data cannot declare resume safe. Recheck fresh backend limits after the deadline, then require all reported buckets below95; a timestamp alone does not resume. A periodic local service updates the gate; assistant checks before new work. No hard-kill during mutations and no third-party notices. An in-flight request can cross95 before its final usage is reported.
